title: Consultant - Data Engineer + AI
description:
**Overview**
Microsoft Industry Solutions - Global Center for Innovation and Delivery Center (GCID) delivers end-to-end solutions by enabling accelerated adoption and productive use of Microsoft technologies. An organization of well over 2000+ exceptional people, GCID presents a great opportunity for highly skilled services professionals to make a foray into consulting, solution development and delivery roles. The ideal consultant is passionate about technology, has breadth rather than specific product depth, and has the drive and courage to articulate and stand up for a great solution delivering true value for the client.
  
  
As a Data & AI consultant, you will deliver quality engagements with your expertise, as a key contributor to high profile data and AI projects to ensure customer value. The ideal candidate must have the ability to combine their technical skills, leadership skills, creativity, and customer focus to deliver great solutions to the customers and ensure they get the best out of our technologies and solutions. Consulting Delivery professionals bring subject matter and solution expertise to architectural teams, customers, and partners. They apply deep technical and business knowledge to accelerate the adoption of Microsoft devices and services by ensuring strategic, architectural, and operational alignment to customer and partner objectives.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Works as an Individual contributor and key member of the Data and AI team and helps in timely execution of assigned deliverables with accurate estimates, work priorities, and accommodates project changes and trade-offs necessary for a successful release.
* Applies technical experience and industry-specific knowledge to develop solutions, based on an analysis of how the proposed approach affects the business objectives of customers and partners.
* Works to accelerate the value proposition of customer/partner engagements by helping to design, develop, and deploy solutions on Microsoft technologies and methodologies.
* Contributes to the overall efficacy and quality of a project team’s technical delivery within assigned engagements.
* Defines dependencies and risks that go beyond the immediate scope and timeframe for a complex project. Develops contingency plans, risk-mitigation implementation criteria, and alternative strategies to manage short- and long-term risks and manages technical escalations.
* Drives opportunities to expand or accelerate the adoption and consumption of cloud and Microsoft technologies. Collaborates, as appropriate, with peers and other teams (e.g., Sales, account-aligned team) to scale the business with existing high-stake or strategic customers, by articulating/developing value propositions of strategic Microsoft products and services.
* Align with innovation and digital transformation initiatives. Ensures the use of existing intellectual property (IP) and delivers value to customers.
* Responsible for implementing the technology strategy with support from Senior peers
* Applies information-compliance and assurance policies to ensure stakeholder confidence.
* Drives new ways of thinking, across the division and subsidiary, to improve quality, engineering productivity, and responsiveness to feedback and changing priorities.
* Consistently upskills through regular trainings and certifications on Azure Data and AI to be able to contribute to the future needs of the organization and customers

**Qualifications**

* 4 - 6 years of experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science engineering or equivalent work experience. Higher relevant education is preferred.
* Knowledge of solution design, planning, development and deployment of complex solutions
* One or more of the following certifications, or an equivalent industry certification is a plus:   Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-600)  / Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI102)  / Microsoft Certified: Azure Solution Architect Expert (AZ-305)

Core Data Engineering & Platform Skills
  
  

* Hands-on experience in Data Engineering across cloud, on-prem, and hybrid environments
* Strong foundational experience with Azure Data Services and data platform modernization initiatives
* Handson exposure to Data Warehouse and analytics using platforms like Microsoft Fabric, and Azure Synapse Analytics; Azure Databricks is a plus
* Experience/knowledge of one or more SQL and NoSQL database systems
* Hands-on experience building AI-powered data pipelines using ETL/ELT tools like:
* Azure Data Factory (ADF), SSIS, Talend, Informatica, Airflow
* Exposure to data migrations, platform upgrades, and modernization efforts
* Understanding of multitenant data platform designs, basic security hardening, and access control concepts
* Knowledge of Big Data ecosystems like Spark, Databricks, Kafka, Hadoop, etc.

AI / ML Foundations
  
  

* Experience building or supporting ML ready datasets and basic feature engineering
* Exposure to operationalizing ML pipelines and MLOps concepts, on Azure stack
* Foundational knowledge of:
* Large Language Models (LLMs)
* Model training, evaluation, and deployment workflows
* Azure cloud and AI stack like Azure Foundry, Azure OpenAI, etc
* Handson experience or knowledge in one or more of:
* NLP, Document Intelligence & Indexing
* Computer Vision
* RAG frameworks or AI Search
* Basic understanding of Prompt Engineering
* Exposure to or knowledge of deep learning/Gen AI frameworks such as TensorFlow/PyTorch, and orchestration frameworks like LangChain/LangGraph
* Familiarity with Responsible AI principles – fairness, interpretability, and governance

Engineering Practices & Delivery
  
  

* Experience working in Agile teams with knowledge of/exposure to Azure DevOps
* Understanding of DataOps and MLOps practices, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment workflows, preferably on Azure Foundry
* Knowledge of secure coding practices, observability basics, and performance considerations
* Handson programming experience, preferably in Python

Consulting Mindset & Collaboration
  
  

* Ability to work closely with senior consultants, architects, and customers to co-create innovative solutions with customers to help solve their business challenges
* Strong communication skills to explain technical concepts to business stakeholders
* Comfortable working in ambiguous environments, learning quickly, and adapting to change
* Eagerness to build engineering excellence, reusable components, and best practices

Growth & Learning Orientation
  
  

* Strong interest in continuous learning and technical certifications
* Curiosity to explore emerging data and AI technologies
* Willingness to receive feedback, grow technical depth, and expand ownership over time

Data Architecture Foundations (Good to have)
  
  

* Good understanding of core data architecture patterns:
* Dimensional modeling
* Lambda and Kappa architectures
* Timeseries data processing
* Familiarity with Azure Stream Analytics and Azure Analysis Services
* Awareness of data governance concepts and tools (opensource or proprietary)

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
  
  
Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about
**requesting accommodations.**

title: Lead Data Engineer - Quantexa
description:
**About Chubb**

Chubb is a world leader in insurance. With operations in 54 countries and territories, Chubb provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance and life insurance to a diverse group of clients. The company is defined by its extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength and local operations globally. Parent company Chubb Limited is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: CB) and is a component of the S&P 500 index. Chubb employs approximately 40,000 people worldwide. Additional information can be found at: www.chubb.com.

**About Chubb India**

At Chubb India, we are on an exciting journey of digital transformation driven by a commitment to engineering excellence and analytics. We are proud to share that we have been officially certified as a Great Place to Work® for the third consecutive year, a reflection of the culture at Chubb where we believe in fostering an environment where everyone can thrive, innovate, and grow

With a team of over 2500 talented professionals, we encourage a start-up mindset that promotes collaboration, diverse perspectives, and a solution-driven attitude. We are dedicated to building expertise in engineering, analytics, and automation, empowering our teams to excel in a dynamic digital landscape.

We offer an environment where you will be part of an organization that is dedicated to solving real-world challenges in the insurance industry. Together, we will work to shape the future through innovation and continuous learning.

**Position Details**

**Job Title: Lead Data Engineer - Quantexa**

**Function/Department: Technology**

**Employment Type: Full-time**

**Location: Hyderabad/Bangalore**

**Reports To: Veera Venkateswara Rao Balla**

**Position Summary:**

The Quantexa Technical Lead is a senior, hands-on leadership role responsible for the end-to-end design, development, implementation, delivery and support of Quantexa solutions. This role requires deep expertise in the Quantexa platform, data engineering, big data technologies and software development best practices. The successful candidate will lead technical teams, drive architecture and design decisions, mentor developers, and ensure the delivery of scalable, secure and high-performing Quantexa solutions. Close collaboration with Product Owners, Solution Architects, Business Analysts, Data Engineers and Business Stakeholders is essential to translate business requirements into technical solutions that deliver measurable business value.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Solution Design & Delivery**

* Own the technical design, quality and successful delivery of Quantexa solutions.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Solution Architects, Business Analysts and stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Define and review technical architecture, solution design and implementation approaches.
* Lead the development and implementation of Quantexa solutions while ensuring adherence to architectural standards and best practices.
* Ensure solutions meet functional and non-functional requirements including scalability, performance, security, maintainability and reliability.
* Identify technical risks and dependencies and establish mitigation strategies.
* Drive automation and standardisation across development and deployment processes.
* Support production deployments, troubleshooting and issue resolution.
* Manage and reduce technical debt through proactive design and engineering improvements.

**Quantexa Technical Leadership**

* Provide technical leadership across multiple Quantexa workstreams and projects.
* Act as the primary technical escalation point for development teams and stakeholders.
* Lead architecture reviews, code reviews, design reviews and performance reviews.
* Establish technical standards, development guidelines and governance processes.
* Champion best practices in software engineering and Quantexa development.
* Guide teams in designing scalable and reusable Quantexa frameworks and components.
* Drive technical innovation and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Quantexa Platform Expertise**

Lead and provide hands-on expertise across:

* Quantexa ETL Frameworks
* Entity Resolution (ER) -- design, configuration and tuning
* Network Generation -- graph construction and optimisation
* Graph Scripting -- custom traversal and scoring logic
* Compound Design and Optimisation
* Scoring Framework Development
* Alerting Framework Configuration
* Task Loading Framework
* Decision Intelligence Workflows
* Data Ingestion and Processing Pipelines
* Historical, Incremental and Near Real-Time Processing
* Performance Tuning and Optimisation
* Batch Processing Frameworks
* Data Quality and Validation Frameworks

**Team Development & Mentorship**

* Mentor Quantexa developers and data engineers.
* Drive technical capability development within the team.
* Promote knowledge sharing and continuous learning.
* Support team members in achieving Quantexa certifications and technical growth goals.
* Conduct regular technical reviews and provide constructive feedback.
* Foster a collaborative, high-performance engineering culture.

**Engineering Excellence**

* Perform detailed code reviews and design reviews.
* Champion development best practices, coding standards, testing frameworks and CI/CD processes.
* Implement reusable frameworks, accelerators and development standards.
* Ensure appropriate monitoring, logging, alerting and support mechanisms are in place.
* Drive performance optimisation across Quantexa pipelines and applications.
* Support root cause analysis and resolution of production issues.

**REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

**Quantexa Experience**

* Proven experience leading multiple Quantexa implementations including Proof of Concept (PoC), Pilot Programmes and Enterprise Implementations.
* Strong expertise in Quantexa platform architecture and development.
* Hands-on experience configuring and optimising qModel, qEntity, qElement, qCompound, Scoring Frameworks, Alerting Frameworks, Task Loading Frameworks and Graph Scripts.
* Expertise in Entity Resolution design and tuning.
* Expertise in Compound development and optimisation.
* Strong experience in Quantexa ETL framework implementation and troubleshooting.
* Experience tuning large-scale Quantexa pipelines for performance and scalability.
* Strong understanding of Network Generation and Decision Intelligence methodologies.
* Quantexa Certified Professional or Technical Lead Certification preferred.

**Data Engineering & Big Data**

* Strong hands-on experience with Scala, Apache Spark, Hadoop Ecosystem and SQL.
* Experience designing and building large-scale distributed data processing solutions.
* Strong understanding of data modelling, data quality, ETL processes, data integration and data validation frameworks.
* Experience with high-volume data processing environments.

**DevOps & Cloud**

* Experience with Git, Jenkins, Azure DevOps and CI/CD Pipelines.
* Understanding of DevOps principles and release management.
* Experience deploying applications in cloud environments (Microsoft Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Knowledge of monitoring, logging, observability and operational support processes.

**Preferred Domain Experience**

Experience delivering Quantexa solutions within one or more of the following domains:

* Financial Crime & AML
* Fraud Detection
* Customer Intelligence
* Insurance Analytics
* Risk & Compliance / KYC / CDD
* Banking & Financial Services

**Technical Skills Summary**

Mandatory:

* Quantexa Platform -- ETL, Entity Resolution, Network Generation, Graph Scripting, Scoring Framework, Alerting Framework, Task Loading Framework, Compound Development, Performance Tuning
* Scala |Apache Spark | Hadoop| SQL |Git | CI/CD

Preferred:

* Python |Elasticsearch | Kafka| REST APIs |Docker | Kubernetes
* Azure |AWS | GCP

**KEY COMPETENCIES**

**Technical Leadership:**
Ability to provide technical direction, define engineering standards and guide teams through complex technical challenges.

**Solution Ownership:**
Accountable for solution design, build quality, delivery and operational success.

**Problem Solving:**
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to resolve complex business and technical challenges.

**Communication:**
Effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Mentorship:**
Develop technical capabilities within teams through coaching, training and knowledge sharing.

**Stakeholder Management:**
Build strong relationships with Product Owners, Architects, Business Analysts, Delivery Managers and Business Stakeholders.

**Delivery Excellence:**
Demonstrated ability to deliver enterprise-scale Quantexa solutions on schedule while maintaining high quality standards.

**EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field.
* Quantexa Certification preferred.
* Relevant Cloud Certification (Azure / AWS / GCP) is a plus.

**EXPERIENCE**

* 8+ years of software development and data engineering experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on Quantexa implementation experience.
* Proven experience leading enterprise-scale Quantexa delivery teams.
* Experience managing technical delivery across multiple Quantexa projects and environments.

**IDEAL CANDIDATE**

An experienced Quantexa leader with deep expertise in ETL, Entity Resolution, Graph Scripting, Compounds, Scoring, Alerting, Task Loading, Performance Tuning, Scala, Spark and enterprise-scale Quantexa implementations -- capable of driving both technical excellence and successful delivery outcomes.

**Why Join Us?**

* Be at the forefront of digital transformation in the insurance industry.
* Lead impactful initiatives that simplify claims processing and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, innovation-driven environment.

**Why Chubb?**

Join Chubb to be part of a leading global insurance company!

Our constant focus on employee experience along with a start-up-like culture empowers you to achieve impactful results.

* **Industry leader:**
  Chubb is a world leader in the insurance industry, powered by underwriting and engineering excellence
* **A Great Place to work:**
  Chubb India has been recognized as a Great Place to Work® for the years 2023-2024, 2024-2025 and 2025-2026
* **Laser focus on excellence**
  : At Chubb we pride ourselves on our culture of greatness where excellence is a mindset and a way of being. We constantly seek new and innovative ways to excel at work and deliver outstanding results
* **Start-Up Culture**
  : Embracing the spirit of a start-up, our focus on speed and agility enables us to respond swiftly to market requirements, while a culture of ownership empowers employees to drive results that matter
* **Growth and success**
  : As we continue to grow, we are steadfast in our commitment to provide our employees with the best work experience, enabling them to advance their careers in a conducive environment

**Employee Benefits**

Our company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees’ health, well-being, and professional growth. Employees enjoy flexible work options, generous paid time off, and robust health coverage, including treatment for dental and vision related requirements. We invest in the future of our employees through continuous learning opportunities and career advancement programs, while fostering a supportive and inclusive work environment. Our benefits include:

* Savings and Investment plans: We provide specialized benefits like Corporate NPS (National Pension Scheme), Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), Long-Term Incentive Plan (LTIP), Retiral Benefits and Car Lease that help employees optimally plan their finances
* Upskilling and career growth opportunities: With a focus on continuous learning, we offer customized programs that support upskilling like Education Reimbursement Programs, Certification programs and access to global learning programs.
* Health and Welfare Benefits: We care about our employees’ well-being in and out of work and have benefits like Hybrid Work Environment, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Yearly Free Health campaigns and comprehensive Insurance benefits.

title: Associate Data Engineer
description:

Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Develop, test, and maintain data pipelines using Databricks, PySpark, and Python.
* Ingest, transform, and process structured and semi-structured data from multiple sources.
* Support the development of scalable ETL/ELT workflows for analytics, reporting, and machine learning use cases.
* Work with data engineers, analysts, and data scientists to understand data requirements and deliver reliable datasets.

3-5 years of experience with bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  
  
**Must-Have Qualifications**

* Understanding of Git or other version control tools.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and data engineering best practices.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, or Lakehouse architecture.
* Experience with workflow orchestration tools or Databricks Jobs.
* Familiarity with CI/CD practices for data engineering projects.
* Exposure to machine learning workflows using MLflow, scikit-learn, or similar tools.
* Experience with Tableau, Power BI, or similar data visualization tools to create dashboards, support reporting needs, validate datasets, and perform exploratory analysis.

title: Spydra - Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer - Data Modeling
description:
**Job Description : Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer**
**Key Skills :**
Data Modelling, Microsoft Fabric Notebook, Fabric Pipeline, Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a skilled Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer with strong expertise in data modelling and hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing scalable data models, developing data pipelines, and building efficient Lakehouse and Warehouse solutions to support enterprise analytics and reporting.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain robust data models for analytical and reporting requirements.
* Build and optimize data processing solutions using Microsoft Fabric Notebooks.
* Develop, orchestrate, monitor, and troubleshoot Microsoft Fabric Data Pipelines.
* Design and implement Lakehouse solutions for structured and semi-structured data processing.
* Develop and maintain Fabric Warehouse solutions for analytical workloads.
* Apply OneLake concepts, including unified data storage, data organization, and data access across the Microsoft Fabric ecosystem.
* Optimize data ingestion, transformation, query performance, and storage efficiency.
* Implement data quality checks, validation rules, and data consistency measures.
* Collaborate with data analysts, BI developers, architects, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable data solutions.
* Follow best practices for data security, governance, performance, and maintainability.

**Mandatory Skills**

* Data Modelling : Strong knowledge of conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling; dimensional modelling; star and snowflake schemas; facts and dimensions; and slowly changing dimensions (SCD).
* Microsoft Fabric Notebook : Hands-on experience developing data transformation and processing solutions using notebooks, preferably with PySpark and SQL.
* Fabric Pipeline : Experience building and managing data ingestion, orchestration, scheduling, and dependency workflows.
* Lakehouse : Understanding of Lakehouse architecture, Delta tables, data ingestion, and transformation patterns.
* Warehouse : Experience designing analytical warehouse structures and implementing efficient SQL-based data solutions.
* OneLake Concepts : Understanding of OneLake architecture, data organization, shortcuts, and data sharing across Fabric workloads.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with SQL and Python/PySpark.
* Familiarity with medallion architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold).
* Understanding of ETL/ELT design patterns and incremental data loading.
* Knowledge of data governance, security, and performance optimization.
* Exposure to Power BI and enterprise analytics environments.

**Experience And Qualifications**

* Relevant hands-on experience in data engineering and Microsoft Fabric.
* Strong practical experience in data modelling and analytical data architecture.
* Experience delivering production-ready data solutions in a cloud-based environment.
* Microsoft Fabric or relevant Azure data certifications are an advantage.

**Success Criteria**

* Deliver scalable and maintainable data models.
* Build reliable and efficient Fabric pipelines and notebooks.
* Implement effective Lakehouse and Warehouse solutions.
* Apply OneLake capabilities to support unified data access and reuse.
* Ensure data quality, performance, and reliability across data workflows.

title: Global Network Design Data Engineer, End-to-End Supply Chain
description:
**Overview**
This role supports the next generation network design capability, for all Global BUs, Sectors, and ND Global Capability Centers, across the End-to-End Value Chain. The role primarily supports the development, enhancement, and maintenance of the centralized data foundation (e.g. EDF GND Gold) feeding PepsiCo’s SC network models. It helps ensure that model-ready data is accurate, standardized, well-documented, and available for strategic network models (e.g. clean sheet) and related planning models (e.g. capacity/production planning, innovation analysis, asset/investment scenarios). The role may also work with PEP’s data science team to support data preparation, transformation and analysis related to developing data automation and data insights generation related to SC Network Design.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand data requirements and objectives, to build and maintain the right data solutions supporting network modeling data ingestion and transformation (R),Develop and maintain data pipelines and ETL processes for data extraction, transformation, and loading to make it available in the right structure for the modelers to use (R),Collect, clean, and analyze large datasets using statistical techniques, data mining tools or leveraging upcoming AI/Agentic approaches and frameworks to data engineering (A)/(R),In collaboration with capability and IT teams, help maintain/update the (cloud-based) centralized data layer supporting the global network design modeling capabilities (C) / (R),Identify opportunities for increased the degree of data automation and increase the quality and flexibility of data automation (e.g. user controls) (R),Perform data analysis and establish data quality metrics, monitoring mechanisms, and remediation processes to proactively identify and address data quality issues (A) / (R)
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Degree preferred in IT/IS/CS, Data Analytics, Data Engineering, Data Science or similar
* Proven experience (3 years) in data management, data engineering, data modeling and/or data science
* Strong data engineering and database skills in SQL, databricks or similar/popular ETL tools as well as Excel
* Experience with cloud-based architecture and platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), data retrieval, querying and data pipeline creation including working with large datasets (Millions+ records, complex joins/querying)
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with stakeholders across geographies & communicate complex findings and concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Experience with data visualization tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau)
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Process oriented with great documentation skills
* Advanced level of English, other languages can be nice to have
* Relations: Building and maintaining trusting relationships across organizational boundaries by modelling integrity, transparency, and authenticity, and being respectful and inclusive of others

Additional, Nice to have:
  
  

* Experience with supply chain datasets
* Experience with or supporting supply chain network design projects and work

* Data engineering experience focused on supporting Generative AI technologies.
* Hands on experience with Snowflake
* Experience with building Data and AI pipelines that bring together structured, semi-structured and unstructured data. This includes pre-processing with extraction, chunking, embedding and grounding strategies, semantic modeling, and getting the data ready for Models and Agentic solutions.
* Strong hands-on experience implementing production ready enterprise grade GenAI data solutions.
* Experience with prompt engineering techniques for large language models.
* Experience in implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, integrating retrieval mechanisms with language models.
* Intermediate mastery in processing and leveraging unstructured data for GenAI applications.
* Intermediate mastery in implementing scalable AI driven data systems supporting agentic solutions (AWS Lambda, S3, EC2, Langchain, Langgraph, MCP, A2A).
* Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Experience in vector databases, graph databases, NoSQL, Document DBs, including design, implementation, and optimization. (e.g., AWS open search, GCP Vertex AI, Neo4j, Spanner Graph, Neptune, Mongo, DynamoDB etc.).
* Mastery in implementing data governance practices, including Data Quality, Lineage, Data Catalogue capture, holistically, strategically, and dynamically on a large-scale data platform.

* Expert level collaboration skills across teams, decision making, conflict resolution and relationship building skills.
* Expertise in mentoring and developing Junior AI or Data Engineers.

title: Principal Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
**👋🏼We're Nagarro.**
We are a Digital Product Engineering company that is scaling in a big way! We build products, services, and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. We work at a scale — across all devices and digital mediums, and our people exist everywhere in the world (18500+ experts across 39 countries, to be exact). Our work culture is dynamic and non-hierarchical. We are looking for great new colleagues. That is where you come in!
  
  
**Requirements**
Job Description
  
  

* Experience : 11+yrs
* Extensive hands-on experience in Snowflake architecture, data platform engineering, and enterprise data solution design.
* Strong expertise in Snowflake account, warehouse, database, and schema design, including multi-cluster warehouses and multi-environment strategies.
* Advanced SQL skills, including complex queries, stored procedures, incremental processing, query profiling, and performance optimization.
* Strong Python programming skills for data processing, API integration, automation, and Snowflake development using Snowpark and libraries such as pandas.
* Working knowledge of SQL Server, including database concepts, SQL querying, and integration with enterprise data platforms.
* Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory for data ingestion, orchestration, and integration workflows.
* Strong knowledge of Snowflake Dynamic Tables, Streams, Tasks, Snowpark, semantic views and models, Secure Data Sharing, cloning, Time Travel, replication, and failover.
* Proven experience with Snowflake governance capabilities, including RBAC, masking policies, row access policies, object tagging, tag-based masking, data classification, data quality monitoring functions (DMFs), Access History, and Object Dependencies.
* Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, Data Vault, hybrid modeling, and layered or medallion architecture patterns.
* Experience defining canonical keys, managing loosely typed source data, implementing deduplication, and preventing join fanout across related business domains.
* Expertise in ETL/ELT architecture and data pipeline development, with familiarity with dbt, Airflow, dbt Cloud, or native Snowflake Tasks.
* Experience integrating Salesforce CRM, market data feeds, third-party data sources, APIs, files, and streaming data into Snowflake.
* Understanding of Commercial Real Estate data domains, including property, building, lease, availability, sales, brokerage, valuations, capital markets, and property management.
* Experience integrating Snowflake with PostgreSQL, BI platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker, and application technologies such as Streamlit and React.
* Knowledge of geospatial data enrichment, property coordinates, and geocoding workflows.
* Strong understanding of enterprise security architecture, RBAC design, segregation of duties, PII protection, and regulatory requirements such as GDPR and CCPA.
* Experience with Snowflake network policies, PrivateLink, External Access Integrations, secure connectivity, and egress controls.
* Hands-on experience with Git-based deployment, Terraform or equivalent IaC tools, schemachange, dbt, and CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar platforms.
* Experience with environment promotion, release and rollback strategies, test-data cloning, operational monitoring, and alerting.
* Strong knowledge of at least one cloud platform, preferably Microsoft Azure, including storage, networking, virtual machines, identity, and key management services.
* Familiarity with containerization technologies such as Docker; experience with Snowpark Container Services is an advantage.
* Experience enabling semantic layers, natural-language querying, governed LLM access, and AI-powered analytics is desirable.
* Familiarity with Snowflake Cortex, feature-store architecture, machine learning data-access patterns, and agent-aware security controls is an advantage.
* Demonstrated architectural leadership, including design reviews, reference architecture development, standards enforcement, and mentoring data engineers.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate across business, data, security, application, and infrastructure teams.
* Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain architecture decisions, security controls, and cost-performance trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with sound judgment in resolving ambiguous requirements, assessing risks, and recommending practical solutions.
* Demonstrated delivery management skills, including the ability to manage multiple initiatives, dependencies, and timelines across distributed teams.
* Relevant Snowflake, cloud architecture, or data engineering certifications are preferred.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end Snowflake platform architecture, including account and organization topology, databases, schemas, virtual warehouses, and development, UAT, and production environments.
* Design and implement scalable data architecture and layered data models, including raw, staging, curated, and semantic layers for Commercial Real Estate (CRE) domains such as property, lease, availability, sales, organization, and contact.
* Define semantic views and semantic models that expose governed, business-friendly data for BI reporting, natural-language querying, and LLM-powered analytics.
* Establish warehouse sizing, scaling, workload isolation, naming conventions, object ownership, and reusable architecture standards.
* Define dimensional, Data Vault, or hybrid data models and canonical join keys to ensure data consistency and prevent duplicate records and join fanout across property, lease, and sales domains.
* Lead ETL/ELT pipeline architecture for batch and streaming ingestion from Salesforce CRM, market data feeds, APIs, files, and third-party CRE data providers.
* Leverage Snowflake Dynamic Tables, Streams, Tasks, and Snowpark to implement transformations, incremental processing, and automated data workflows.
* Establish data engineering standards for data typing, casting, deduplication, data quality, and handling wide or loosely typed source tables.
* Design and implement Snowflake security architecture, including role-based access control (RBAC), role hierarchies, functional access roles, and segregation of duties.
* Implement data protection controls such as column-level masking, row access policies, object tagging, tag-based masking, sensitive-data classification, and auditing.
* Ensure compliance with GDPR, CCPA, client confidentiality requirements, and restrictions governing personally identifiable information (PII) and confidential deal data.
* Define network security, secure connectivity, egress controls, External Access Integrations, and secure data-sharing patterns.
* Design integration architectures between Snowflake, PostgreSQL, downstream applications, BI tools, and application layers such as Streamlit and React.
* Govern Secure Data Sharing and provider-consumer data exchange with brokers, partners, and external data providers.
* Oversee geospatial and market-data enrichment pipelines, including property coordinates and geocoding, while ensuring compliance with network and data security restrictions.
* Optimize Snowflake query performance using clustering keys, search optimization, partition pruning, and result and metadata caching.
* Establish FinOps practices covering warehouse auto-suspend and auto-resume, resource monitors, budget controls, credit consumption, and cost attribution by project or cost center.
* Define platform SLAs, monitoring, alerting, capacity planning, and operational procedures, including tracking serverless compute costs.
* Enable AI-driven analytics and natural-language querying through governed semantic models and Snowflake Cortex where appropriate.
* Collaborate with data science teams to support feature stores, machine learning data access, and secure access to sensitive data attributes.
* Ensure LLMs and AI agents respect masking policies, row-level security, and appropriate access controls.
* Establish Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), Git-based deployment, and CI/CD practices for Snowflake objects and semantic models using Terraform, schemachange, dbt, or equivalent tools.
* Define environment promotion, test-data cloning, release management, rollback procedures, and deployment standards.
* Implement observability using Snowflake query history, Account Usage views, Information Schema, logging, and alerting, supported by operational runbooks.
* Own the Snowflake platform roadmap, evaluate new features and editions, and establish reference architectures and engineering standards.
* Act as the technical design authority by conducting architecture reviews, mentoring engineers, enforcing best practices, and guiding implementation decisions.
* Translate business requirements across brokerage, valuations, capital markets, and property management into scalable data platform capabilities.
* Collaborate with business, security, infrastructure, application, and data engineering teams to communicate architecture trade-offs, performance considerations, and cost implications.

**Qualifications**
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Fulfillment Technology (AFT), Platform Engineering and Services
description:
**Description**
Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) powers the physical engine at the heart of Amazon — magically turning your click of a button into packages at your door. Within AFT, the Labor Insights team builds and operates the platform that tracks on associate labor performance across Amazon's entire global warehouse network. Labor Insights' suite of 18+ services supports ~1 million associates and 70,000+ daily portal users across 9,800+ facilities and 10 business lines — ingesting over 19 billion labor events annually to produce the real-time productivity reports that warehouse managers rely on to run their operations every day. We leverage AWS technologies, stream processing, and AI/ML to build distributed, highly available systems that operate at massive scale.
  
  
Are you ready for a challenge? As a Software Development Engineer on the Labor Insights team, you will build the next generation of Amazon's labor management platform — designing systems that ingest billions of labor events from warehouse floor tools and time clock systems, aggregate them through multi-stage pipelines, and serve real-time productivity reports to operations managers across the globe. You will own design and development of distributed systems that refresh reports every 10–15 minutes across 3 global regions while maintaining 99.9% availability. You will contribute to a wide range of projects — from event processing pipelines and aggregation engines to reporting APIs, modern React-based portals, and AI-powered configuration tools. Most excitingly, you will help drive refresh of the existing tool, an AI-first greenfield initiative to rebuild the platform from the ground up using modern stream-based architecture, eliminating a decade of technical debt and delivering near real-time metrics. You will be involved in all aspects of the software development cycle including scoping, design, implementation, testing, and delivery. A commitment to teamwork, hustle, and strong communication skills are absolute requirements. Creating reliable, scalable, and high-performance services requires exceptional technical expertise. If you have that expertise, are customer-centric, and motivated about building systems that operate at global scale, then we want to talk to you!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and test software components across Labor Insights' ingestion, aggregation, reporting, and configuration layers — handling labor events, time clock punches, employee location tracking, and productivity report generation
* Build new services using AI-assisted development practices, leveraging tools like Amazon Q and Bedrock to achieve high-velocity delivery on greenfield systems
* Design large-scale data processing solutions using DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, S3, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, Lambda, and stream processing frameworks (Cosmos/Flink) optimized for high throughput and low-latency access
* Drive service consolidation and modernization — migrating from legacy infrastructure to Native AWS (NAWS) with full CI/CD pipelines
* Participate in definition of coding standards and apply them in code and design reviews
* Provide estimates for development tasks and negotiate timelines with project leaders
* Mentor junior team members and help them acquire critical skills and best practices
* Document and communicate technical concepts to team members and stakeholders
* Participate in deep technical discussions, where you stand up for your ideas and work with team members to find the best solution for the customer
* Identify technical and project risks and take initiative to mitigate them

A day in the life
  
  
Full-cycle ownership. You contribute to all aspects of the software development cycle — from scoping and design through implementation, testing, and delivery of features that provide labor performance visibility to Amazon's global fulfillment operations.
  
  
Billions-scale data processing. You build systems that ingest 19+ billion labor events per year from warehouse floor tools, time clock systems, and employee location heartbeats. You design multi-stage aggregation pipelines that process this data into PPR and PPA reports refreshed every 10–15 minutes, served to 70K+ daily users across 9,800+ facilities.
  
  
AWS-native architecture. You leverage the full AWS stack — DynamoDB for hot data storage, S3 for historical data, PostgreSQL for aggregated reports, SQS/SNS for event-driven processing, EventBridge and Lambda for serverless job orchestration, and Cosmos/Flink for stream processing. You architect for 99.9% availability across 3 global regions (NA, EU, FE).
  
  
AI-first development. You pioneer AI-assisted engineering practices — using Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Q, and AI-powered tools to accelerate greenfield development at 20X traditional velocity. You build intelligent systems like AI-powered configuration assistants, automated intake routing, and GenAI-driven operational tooling.
  
  
Modernization at scale. You modernize a 15+ year-old platform serving every fulfillment center worldwide — consolidating 23+ services into a clean microservices architecture, rebuilding the portal experience in React from legacy JSP/jQuery, and transitioning from batch to stream processing, all while maintaining zero-downtime operations.
  
  
**About The Team**
About Labor Insights: We build Amazon's global labor management platform — the system of record for measuring associate performance across every fulfillment center, sort center, delivery station, and grocery facility worldwide. Labor Insights tracks how ~1 million associates spend their time, producing the productivity reports (PPR, PPA, attendance, Time Off Task) that operations managers use to make staffing decisions, identify bottlenecks, and ensure customer shipments go out on time.
  
  
**What Makes This Role Exciting**

* Build FCLM 2.0 from the ground up — a once-in-a-career opportunity to greenfield a platform that runs Amazon's global workforce visibility, using AI-first development to deliver in months what would take years through traditional approaches
* Pioneer stream processing — transition from batch to real-time with sub-minute latencies using Cosmos/Flink, fundamentally changing how Amazon tracks labor performance
* Build a multi-tenant platform (FCLM FLEX) — design a configurable translation layer that recasts PPR and PPA as flexible views on the same underlying data, eliminating duplicate pipelines and enabling third-party teams to create custom labor views without engineering support
* Reimagine the portal experience — rebuild the portal used by 70K+ daily users from legacy JSP/jQuery into a modern React application with accessibility, localization, and scalable access controls
* Expand to new businesses — onboard Amazon Grocery (Fresh, Whole Foods) and other new business lines in 2026+, scaling the platform to new node types and labor models
* Build AI-powered tools — design intelligent systems using Amazon Bedrock for automated configuration management, request intake, and operational copilots that serve 1.5M workers globally
* Massive impact — every feature you build is used by tens of thousands of warehouse managers the same day; Labor Insights’ operations save an estimated $25M+ annually

**Our Tenets**

* Build for Scale: Design generically to support multiple use cases beyond Labor Insights
* Service Generalization for Multi-Tenancy: Build abstractions that work across all businesses
* No Data Filtering by Default: Accept all incoming data, build flexible views on top

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The Senior Data Architect position combines strong hands-on technical leadership with the management of matrixed resources to achieve business outcomes. This role is expected to be equally engaged in developing code and developing the skills and competencies of the broader team.

* Foster an innovative, inclusive, and diverse team environment, promoting a positive team culture, encouraging collaboration and self-organization, and delivering high-quality solutions.

* Collaborate on an Agile team to design, develop, test, implement, and support highly scalable data solutions on lakehouse platforms such as Databricks, with particular emphasis on platform data modeling, data flow analysis, and ensuring solutions reflect sound data architecture principles.

**Key Qualifications**
**Experience:**
15+ years of overall experience in data architecture, data engineering, or enterprise data platforms, with substantial hands-on Snowflake experience. Proven ability to lead solution design, data modelling, integration, and implementation of scalable enterprise platforms.
****Education:**
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. Relevant Snowflake, cloud, or data architecture certifications are preferred.**
**SQL, Python, and Performance Optimization:**
Advanced SQL skills covering complex queries, stored procedures, incremental processing, and query tuning. Strong Python experience for data processing, API integration, and automation. Ability to analyze query profiles, optimize warehouse usage, and balance performance with cost.
  
  
**Core Snowflake Expertise :**
Hands-on expertise with Snowflake key features including Account/warehouse/database design, RBAC, resource monitors, multi-cluster warehouses. Dynamic tables, streams, tasks, Snowpark (Python), semantic views/models. Secure Data Sharing, cloning, Time Travel, replication/failover. Snowflake governance suite: masking policies, row access policies, object tagging, tag-based masking, data classification, data quality (DMFs), Access History, Object Dependencies. Cost/performance tuning: clustering, search optimization, pruning, caching, credit attribution.
  
  
**Data Modeling & Engineering :**
Strong dimensional modeling, Data Vault, and medallion/layered architecture patterns. Expert SQL and performance tuning; handling wide, loosely-typed source tables (casting, dedup, canonical keys to avoid fanout). ELT/ETL design; experience with dbt and orchestration (Airflow/dbt Cloud/native tasks). CRE-relevant modeling: property/building spine, lease/availability/sales subject areas, CRM (Salesforce) integration.

title: Lead Product Analyst - Operations
description:
**Company Description**
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
  
  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
  
  
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
  
  
**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
More about
**our mission**
and
**what we offer**
.
  
  
We’re looking for a Lead Data Analyst who is passionate about our mission of Money Without Borders to partner with our operational teams to help drive data-driven decisions that would support our fast-growing product through scaling and optimising the team.
  
  
As a Lead Data Analyst, you'll be driving our analytics efforts in our operations teams, who do everything from support our customers when they need help, to screening for criminal activity, to verifying customer identities at scale.
  
  
Most importantly, you’ll collaborate closely with your operational leads, as well as workforce management, quality, training, and knowledge management, to bring your insights into real change for our customers and help drive our mission!
  
  
**Here’s How You’ll Be Contributing**

* Analytical Capacity Planning and Forecasting: Focus on building and refining analytical models for strategic capacity planning. Take ownership of forecasting efforts to align with business growth and operational demands.
* Data Pipeline Ownership: Take ownership of data pipelines to maintain and improve data flow, ensuring reliability and accuracy.
* Predictive Modeling and Cause and Effect Analysis: Develop and implement robust models to predict outcomes and perform cause and effect analysis to identify key drivers, optimise processes, and enhance decision-making and strategic planning.
* Strategic Support and Analysis: Provide critical insights to assess the operational health of the KYC function, conduct in-depth cost analysis, and offer detailed analysis of operational metrics (including quality) to understand impacts on customer experiences.
* Performance Tracking and Initiative Optimisation: Monitor and track the performance of key strategic initiatives, capitalising on optimisation opportunities to enhance operational outcomes.
* KPI Implementation and Target Setting: Lead the development and implementation of the operations KPI tree and the target-setting framework, integrating these within reporting pipelines and strategic operations.
* Stakeholder Collaboration and Process Standardisation: Collaborate closely with various stakeholders to standardise processes across forecasting, scheduling, and real-time operations, promoting continuous improvement and strategic alignment.

This is an IC3 role. For more information on our Analytics Career Map and levelling structure, click here.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**What you'll bring:**

* You have 6 - 8 years of experience in analytics with a demonstrated ability to approach complex, interconnected problems with a systems mindset.
* You have a strong quantitative and statistical background, comfortable with probability, hypothesis testing, regression, time series analysis, and thinking in terms of models and trade-offs.
* You have experience with operational analytics: efficiency analysis, cost modelling, performance measurement, or process optimisation.
* You think about data as infrastructure. You build with reusability and quality in mind, considering how data will be consumed by dashboards, other teams, and automated systems.
* You have experience with complex data models in SQL (our warehouse is Snowflake) and advanced analysis using Python/R.
* You can tell a story with data and proactively guide strategy based on insights. Experience with visualisation tools like Looker, Superset, or Tableau.
* You have a bias to action and are an excellent communicator, able to own projects end-to-end, form your own opinions, and influence stakeholders across teams.

**Some Extra Skills That Are Great (but Not Essential)**

* Experience with optimisation problems such as queuing theory, scheduling, or resource allocation.
* Familiarity with forecasting techniques (ARIMA, Holt-Winters, or similar time series methods).
* Experience building data foundations that support ML/AI — feature engineering, labelled datasets, or structured event data.
* Prior experience in operations, servicing, or compliance domains.
* Familiarity with workforce management, quality assurance, or knowledge management analytics.
* Experience with dbt, Airflow, or Git.

Additional Information
  
  
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
  
  
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
  
  
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
  
  
If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
  
  
Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

title: BI Engineering Manager
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced
**Business Intelligence Team Manager**
to lead our BI team within Capital Markets Data Solutions.
  
  
The role is responsible for delivering trusted, scalable and intuitive analytics for
**internal stakeholders and external clients**
, with a particular focus on
**Equities and Foreign Exchange Trading**
.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role requiring deep expertise in
**Tableau and data visualisation**
, combined with strong knowledge of
**Snowflake, AWS, Data Engineering and Capital Markets**
. The successful candidate will lead the team, shape the technology roadmap and ensure our BI capability delivers measurable business and client outcomes.
  
  
We are looking for a forward-thinking leader who continually challenges how technology, data and ways of working can be
**faster, simpler, more secure, resilient and cost-effective**
.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach and develop a high-performing BI team.
* Own BI delivery and partner with Product, Data Engineering, Technology, internal stakeholders and external clients.
* Provide technical leadership across Tableau Products (Tableau Cloud, Tableau Server and Tableau Desktop), including visualisation, architecture, performance, administration, authentication, security and deployment.
* Apply strong Equities Trading and FX knowledge to turn complex market, liquidity and execution data into actionable insights.
* Work with Data Engineering teams to optimise data models, pipelines and queries for speed, scalability and user experience.
* Influence the end-to-end architecture across Snowflake, AWS, Tableau and the wider data ecosystem.
* Ensure strong cyber security, data quality, governance, controls and entitlements across BI solutions.
* Establish reliable operational support, monitoring, incident management, resilience and recovery frameworks for critical BI services.
* Champion governed self-service analytics and continuously improve the client and user experience.
* Lead Tableau adoption and the Tableau Centre of Excellence by establishing governance, standards, training, and best practices, enabling secure self-service analytics and driving user adoption.
* Manage relevant technology contracts, licensing, suppliers and renewals, with a focus on commercial and cost optimisation.
* Continually evaluate new BI, cloud, data and AI technologies, driving automation, simplification and modernisation.

**Essential**
**Skills & Experience**

* Significant BI and data visualisation experience, including leadership of technical teams.
* Strong knowledge of Equities and Foreign Exchange Trading markets, including trading, liquidity and execution data.
* Deep Tableau expertise, including advanced visualisation, UI/UX, performance optimisation, administration and enterprise deployment.
* Strong experience with Snowflake and AWS in enterprise data and analytics environments.
* Advanced SQL and strong understanding of data warehousing, dimensional modelling and data engineering.
* Experience optimising the end-to-end journey from data engineering through to visualisation and user experience.
* Strong understanding of cyber security, data governance, controls, lineage and access management.
* Experience establishing and managing reliable production and operational support frameworks.
* Strong stakeholder and client management skills, including experience working with external clients.
* Experience managing technology contracts, licensing, suppliers and renewals.
* Strong commercial awareness and a continuous improvement mindset.
* Demonstrable experience delivering measurable business outcomes through data and BI, including improved decision-making, client experience, efficiency, revenue, risk reduction or cost optimisation.

**Desirable**

* Python
* CI/CD and BI deployment automation
* Experience modernising legacy BI estates
* Exposure to AI-enabled analytics and emerging data technologies

**What Success Looks Like**
Success means building a BI capability that is
**high-performing, client-focused, secure, reliable and continuously improving**
.
  
  
The successful candidate will develop a strong Hyderabad team, improve the performance and user experience of our analytics, strengthen operational resilience and controls, and ensure our investment in
**Tableau, Snowflake and AWS translates into measurable value for Equities, FX, internal stakeholders and external clients**
.
  
  
**This role is ultimately accountable for turning trusted Capital Markets data into fast, intuitive and actionable insights that deliver meaningful business and client outcomes.**
**Our people**
People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.
  
  
We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 65 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers.

description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering Specialist
  
  
Why HSBC
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
This role shapes the end-to-end design and delivery of resilient cloud-native data platforms and microservices. You’ll set technical direction across modernisation of legacy estates while staying close enough to the code to unblock teams and strengthen engineering quality in Java and distributed system design. The focus spans high-performance data pipelines, event-driven integration and production-ready operational standards in a regulated environment. Success means services that are scalable, observable and secure with clear roadmaps that reduce risk and disruption to live operations. You’ll influence senior stakeholders by translating business outcomes into pragmatic technical plans and measurable milestones.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Own solution architecture for high-performance data pipelines and microservices including resilience, scalability, latency, observability and security
* Define modernisation roadmaps across re-platforming, refactoring and microservices decomposition with minimal disruption to live services
* Establish engineering standards for API design, event-driven integration, data modelling, testing strategy, CI/CD and operational readiness
* Manage technical debt through clear prioritisation and measurable outcomes
* Architect, design and build core services using Java (8+), Spring Boot 3, JPA and PostgreSQL (or other RDBMS) using event streaming patterns
* Deliver real-time processing implementations using Apache Flink and/or Apache Beam where appropriate
* Partner with engineers on code reviews, pair debugging, performance tuning and production incident resolution
* Own operational excellence on GCP across monitoring, alerting, capacity planning, reliability improvements and cost optimisation

What we're looking for
  
  

* Bring substantial software engineering experience designing and delivering distributed systems and data-intensive applications
* Demonstrate recent hands-on Java engineering expertise using Spring Boot with REST and event-driven services
* Apply proven system design across microservices patterns, asynchronous messaging, idempotency, consistency models, caching, rate limiting and failure handling
* Show strong SQL capability including performance tuning and working effectively with ORM frameworks such as JPA/Hibernate
* Deliver cloud-native solutions on GCP or an equivalent cloud platform with the ability to translate patterns and services
* Troubleshoot across application, data, infrastructure and performance layers to restore service quickly and prevent recurrence
* Communicate architecture decisions clearly and connect them to business priorities and operational constraints
* Coach and mentor engineers across levels to strengthen craftsmanship, accountability and continuous improvement

Building resilient data services
  
  
If you want to shape modern cloud-native platforms while staying hands-on with Java engineering this role offers real scope to make a visible difference. You’ll set direction for microservices and data pipelines that need to perform under demanding production conditions. The work spans architecture, delivery and operational excellence so improvements show up in reliability, scalability and engineering efficiency. If this aligns with the kind of platform work you want to own we’d welcome your application.
  
  
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

****Job Description****
**Specialist, Cloud Data Engineering**
**The Opportunity**

* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  
****Role Overview****
We are looking for Software Engineers (SE) who can break down and solve complex problems with a strong motivation to get things done with a boots-on-the-ground, pragmatic mindset! Our engineers own their products end to end and influence the way how our products and technology are deployed to facilitate most aspects of drug discovery impacting hundreds of thousands of patients around the world. We are looking for engineers who can creatively handle complex dependencies and ambiguous requirements, competing business priorities, while producing fit-for-purpose, optimal solutions.
  
  
We are hoping that you are passionate about collaborating across the interface between hard-core software development and research and discovery data analysis.
  
  
Our Engineering team builds core components used by our company's Research Labs’ data analytics, visualization, and management workflows. The analysis tools and pipelines built for data processing by our team in partnership with our scientists aim to accelerate research and the discovery of new therapies for our patients.
  
  
We collect, annotate, analyze petabytes of scientific data (multi-omics, chemistry, imaging, safety) used in biomarker research, drug safety/efficacy, drug target discovery, and compendium diagnostic development. We help our scientists to process, analyze scientific data at scale by developing highly parallelized analytical workflows ran on HPC infrastructure (on-prem & cloud); to manage, explore and visualize various scientific data modalities by developing bespoke data models, bioinformatics ETL processes, data retrieval and visualization services using distributed micro-service architecture, FAIR data principles, SPA type dashboards, industry specific regulatory compliant data integrity, auditing, and security access controls.

* Proven ability (3+ years hands-on experience).
