title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Forward Deployed Engineer**

You'll build on top of Saras IQ Product to own the solution and the build for a client requirement - from the first requirements conversation and live customer demos to validated data, one trusted set of metrics, live dashboards, and clean data every morning - as the accountable owner of what gets built as a repeatable product capability.

**About Saras Analytics**

Saras Analytics is an AI and data analytics firm built for ecommerce and omnichannel brands. We help fast growing SMBs and mid-market brands turn disconnected, messy data into decisions — covering ingestion, transformation, and consumption, backed by our own products (Daton and Saras IQ) as the data infrastructure in every engagement.

**Why Now**

Saras is profitable and bootstrapped. We run flat: talent and good ideas move fast here regardless of tenure or title. AI-assisted tooling now lets one engineer take a client from the first requirements conversation to a live, trusted dashboard without waiting on a queue of hand-offs. The Forward Deployed Engineer role is built around that: one owner, end to end, with the tooling to make it fast. Because you build on top of our products rather than around them, what you create for one client requirement becomes capability that every client can use. An FDE joining now helps define what that role looks like at its best.

**The Role**

You'll own the solution and the build for one client account, reporting to an FDE Lead. You build on top of our product, Saras IQ, extending it with software you design and code. You are responsible for interacting directly with the customer — running discovery, demoing what you build, and presenting it to client stakeholders — as well as with the product teams, and you contribute to the product roadmap. Whatever you build, you then become the advisor or implementer of that same capability in the product: you create repeatable solutions that expand what the product can do and maximize revenue impact. On that account you work alongside a Strategic Account Manager, who owns the client relationship and the commercial outcomes, and a Product Manager, who owns product onboarding, enablement, and roadmap, with you as a direct contributor to it. You own what gets built and whether it is right — requirements, software, data, metrics, dashboards, and data quality — with our AI-assisted tooling and our SME leads behind you for the hardest problems.

**The Bar**

Speed & Delivery quality are the top priorities for this role: what you ship is correct, validated against the source of truth before the client sees it, and there on the date you committed to. Speed matters because clients feel it — the shortest path from signed-off requirements to a live, trusted dashboard — but never at the cost of numbers the client can rely on. You build to product standard: what you write is well designed, tested, version-controlled, and reusable, because it is part of the product. You surface risks before they block delivery, and you close every issue with a root cause and a fix, you internally escalate the dependencies on time. The lanes are explicit: you own the solution and the build; the Account Manager owns the relationship and the commercial outcomes; the Product Manager owns product onboarding, enablement, and roadmap, with you as a direct contributor to it.

**What You'll Own**

**1. Own discovery and requirements.**
Join the sales handover to close open questions and call out risks early. Run discovery sessions directly with client stakeholders on the client's core use cases — sales and marketing, contribution margin, customer cohorts, product and inventory — co-design the solution with them, and write the business requirements and metric definitions using Saras' standard templates, reviewing them internally before client sign-off. Build the mock-ups that let clients react before anything is built, demo working builds live to the client at every milestone and take their feedback directly, write the test cases every requirement will be validated against, and track change requests so scope stays visible to you and the Account Manager.

**2. Own the data build.**
Set up integrations and access with our data-ingestion team, translate requirements into technical specifications, and build the staging, master, and presentation datasets with Saras' AI-assisted data-engineering tools, following our data-model conventions (dbt, BigQuery, Git). Apply PII masking, and keep the data dictionary and lineage documentation current. When a problem goes beyond your account — a complex architecture choice or a platform limit — take it to the senior data-engineering lead with a proposed workaround, and keep ownership of the outcome.

**3. Build on top of the product, end to end.**
You are not only modelling data: you build complete solutions on top of Saras IQ, and that takes software & data engineering & Analytics skills. Design and code the services, APIs, integrations, automation, and application logic around the data layer, and apply sound engineering practice — modular design, code review, automated tests, version control, and CI/CD. Write code that others can maintain and extend, because it may become part of the product.

**4. Turn what you build into product.**
Whatever you build, you become the advisor or implementer of that same capability in the product. Package it as a repeatable, configurable solution rather than a one-off, document it, and help other FDEs and accounts adopt it, so each engagement expands what the product can do and maximizes its revenue impact.

**5. Own the client's metric definitions.**
Configure one certified set of metrics and dimensions for each client in Saras IQ's semantic layer, so that every dashboard, self-serve question, and AI answer draws on the same definitions.

**6. Own validation before anything reaches the client**
. Reconcile every dataset against its source of truth, certify it, and run the internal sign-off against agreed criteria for sending work back. Set up the data quality and completeness checks, validate against the requirement test cases and against a benchmark set of business questions the AI analyst must answer correctly, then walk the Account Manager through the build in a final review before it goes to the client.

**7. Own the consumption layer.**
Build dashboards natively in Saras IQ (and in Tableau, Luzmo, or Power BI where the contract specifies), drawing their metrics from the client's certified definitions. Build and maintain the business context that powers Saras IQ Analyst, our AI analyst; set it up and provision it for client users in Slack and their AI tools; and keep refining that context from what users ask it. The Account Manager leads the launch and adoption, and the Product Manager leads enablement.

**8. Own data quality every day.**
Run the daily data-quality cycle: confirm the overnight pipelines and checks have completed, resolve what they flag, escalate anything still open — or late upstream data — to the senior data-engineering lead, re-run and re-test what you fixed, and send the client a routine data-quality status (with any help you need from them), copying the Account Manager. Configure latency and dashboard alerts, and close every bug and change request with a root cause and a fix. When an issue breaches its SLA or stays open past a day, the Account Manager takes the client escalation and you drive the fix.

**9. Run your delivery hygiene.**
Keep your onboarding and project documentation, task tracker, and timesheets current, so anyone can see where your account stands.

**10. Partner across the lanes.**
Be the direct technical voice to customers and to the product teams, and contribute to the product roadmap. Support your Account Manager with the technical answers behind success criteria, client acceptance testing, and adoption, and demo what you built and walk client users through its logic yourself, while the Account Manager owns the relationship and the commercial conversations; work with the Product Manager and the product teams to turn what you hear from customers and learn from your builds into roadmap priorities; and work with our data-ingestion and data-engineering teams to unblock ingestion, data quality, and architecture issues.

**What Winning Looks Like**

**First 90 days:**

you know your account's data and metric definitions in depth, you run the daily data-quality cycle reliably, and you've taken at least one deliverable from signed-off requirements to a validated, live dashboard on your own, demoing it to the client yourself.

**Steady state:**

you deliver datasets and dashboards independently and on the committed date, your validation catches issues before clients ever do, your client's mornings start with clean data, your FDE Lead trusts what you ship without re-checking every number, your teammates enjoy working with you, what you've built is reusable and part of the product, you contribute to the roadmap, and you're ready to own a new account launch end to end.

**Who Thrives Here**

Any of these backgrounds can get you in the room. Across all of them, you bring 3+ years (typically 3–6) of hands-on data and software work — some of it building in SQL and code, and some of it facing clients, including demos.

• You've been a business or data analyst who wrote requirements and specifications, worked hands-on in SQL, and are ready to own the build as well as the brief.

• You've been an analytics or data engineer who built layered data models — raw, staging, masters, presentation — and are ready to own the client conversation as well as the pipeline.

• You've delivered data or BI projects in an analytics consulting or services firm, end to end, directly with clients.

• You've been a software engineer who built backend or full-stack applications and data-heavy products, and are ready to take on analytics, data modelling, and the client conversation.

**Whichever route you come from, you have:**

• A degree from a reputed engineering college.

**Senior Data Engineer — Search Platform - Java - OpenSearch - Elasticsearch**
**Role Overview**
Nasuni is building the next generation of enterprise search across massive volumes of unstructured data. As a
**Senior Data Engineer**
on our
**Search Platform team**
, you will own the data ingestion and transformation systems that power search at global scale.
  
  
This role is for engineers who enjoy building
**production-grade data platforms**
, solving
**high-scale indexing challenges**
, and owning systems end-to-end—from source data to search-ready schemas. It is not a role for early-career engineers or purely analytics-focused data roles.
  
  
You will work closely with Search, Platform, and Quality Engineering partners to ensure that data flowing into OpenSearch is reliable, performant, and designed for relevance, experimentation, and long-term scalability.
  
  
**Level & Scope Definition**

* Owns end-to-end ingestion pipelines feeding Nasuni’s search platform
* Operates with high autonomy on design and implementation decisions
* Responsible for schema design, data quality, and indexing performance
* Execution-focused with architectural accountability
* No people management responsibilities
* Collaborates cross-functionally with Search, Platform, and Quality teams

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and operate production-grade ETL/ELT services, primarily in Java, that transform source data into optimized OpenSearch schemas
* Solve large-scale indexing challenges in a multi-tenant, multi-region, multi-cloud SaaS environment
* Build and maintain high-throughput ingestion services using batch and streaming patterns
* Implement monitoring, alerting, and logging to ensure data completeness, accuracy, and operational stability

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, India
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.
  
  
Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.
  
  
**About The Role**
Notion is looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer focused on migrations to join our growing team in India. You will help deliver complex, production-grade data migrations, integrations, and automations for customers across APAC.
  
  
This is initially an internally focused, hands-on engineering role. You will partner closely with regional Forward Deployed Engineers, who own customer discovery, solution architecture, stakeholder communication, risk management, and final customer validation. You will own the behind-the-scenes technical execution layer from feasibility assessment and implementation through testing, production rollout, QA, reconciliation, reporting, and operational handoff.
  
  
You will work across multiple customer environments and source systems, often with incomplete requirements, imperfect data, and real-world constraints. Success requires strong engineering fundamentals, sound judgment, careful validation, and the ability to turn one-off delivery work into reusable tools and repeatable playbooks.
  
  
As a founding engineer in India, you will help build a new regional engineering capability from the ground up. You will create migration infrastructure, standards, and reusable tooling used by FDEs across APAC, while establishing practices that can scale globally. The role offers an opportunity to become a technical authority for production migration delivery, shaping how Notion approaches reliability, validation, and operational quality across complex customer environments. As the team grows, the role may also expand toward customer-facing FDE work, technical leadership, or a deeper engineering path, depending on business needs and demonstrated capability.
  
  
**What You'll Achieve**

* Own the technical execution layer after customer requirements, scope, and solution architecture have been established with the regional FDE. Contribute to feasibility assessment, estimation, implementation planning, and risk identification while the regional FDE remains accountable for customer discovery, scope, architecture, stakeholder communication, and final acceptance.
* Apply a repeatable migration lifecycle covering source inventory and sampling, scope and pruning decisions, compatibility and degradation assessment, transformation design, pilot or dry run, user acceptance testing, production cutover, reconciliation, remediation, hypercare, and documented handoff.
* Translate approved customer and regional FDE requirements into clear technical designs, implementation plans, test strategies, runbooks, and delivery estimates.
* Build production-quality migration utilities, backend services, data pipelines, integrations, and automations using Python, SQL, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure.
* Investigate source-system behavior, data quality issues, permissions, rate limits, authentication constraints, and edge cases, then recommend practical solutions.
* Design and validate permissions, ownership, and inheritance mappings against the approved migration plan. Make unsupported or ambiguous access requirements explicit, obtain the required decision or approval, and preserve evidence of validation.
* Design migrations for reliability, scale, security, observability, idempotency, failure recovery, and safe reruns.
* Execute migrations only through approved environments, devices, accounts, and tooling. Follow least-privilege access, customer-specific security and data-residency requirements, and approved handling procedures. Do not store customer data in unmanaged local or external systems, and escalate privacy, security, or sovereignty concerns before execution.
* Build validation and reconciliation frameworks that provide clear evidence of migration completeness, accuracy, and exceptions.
* Debug failures across application code, infrastructure, customer data, third-party systems, and the Notion platform, then drive issues through resolution.
* Manage multiple implementation workstreams, dependencies, and priorities while communicating scope, progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly.
* Surface scope changes, unsupported requirements, timeline risks, and material effort increases early. Document assumptions and trade-offs, and escalate with options and a recommended path rather than silently absorbing additional work.
* Maintain an auditable record of scope, decisions, risks, approvals, validation evidence, and customer acceptance criteria in the agreed shared workspace or channel.
* Convert repeated delivery patterns into reusable components, automation, documentation, and playbooks that improve speed, quality, and cost over time.
* Bring field learnings back to Notion's Product and Engineering teams as actionable platform feedback and technical requirements.

**Skills You'll Need To Bring**

* 3 to 6 years of hands-on experience in backend engineering, data engineering, integration engineering, implementation engineering, technical consulting, solutions engineering, or a similar technical role.
* Strong hands-on Python development experience.
* Working experience with Node.js, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
* Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of relational databases, data modeling, and data transformation.
* Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, authentication, webhooks, and system integrations.
* Experience owning a production migration, integration, or technical implementation through mapping, transformation, testing, rollout, validation, and handoff.
* Experience taking a technical problem from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production operation.
* Experience with Git, code review, automated testing, release practices, and production deployment.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills across code, data, infrastructure, and external systems.
* Evidence of working on production systems, not only prototypes or proof-of-concept projects.
* Clear written and verbal English communication, with the ability to explain technical decisions, constraints, and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* High agency and ownership. You are comfortable making progress with incomplete information, challenging assumptions, and escalating with options and a recommendation.

**Nice To Haves**

* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, job orchestration, or infrastructure automation.
* Experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Familiarity with message queues, event-driven systems, distributed-system patterns, retries, concurrency, and rate limits.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, or other observability tools.
* Experience with enterprise SaaS applications, professional services, or large-scale customer implementations.
* Experience migrating large volumes of content or structured data between enterprise platforms.
* Experience with AI or LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation frameworks, or agentic workflows.
* Familiarity with MCP, tool calling, Notion Workers, Custom Agents, or similar extensibility platforms.
* Experience working with distributed global or APAC teams.

**What Success Looks Like**
**In your first 90 days, you will:**

* Learn Notion's migration and implementation ecosystem, engineering standards, and APAC delivery model.
* Establish a productive working rhythm with regional FDE partners.
* Contribute to at least one migration or integration workstream through production delivery.
* Leave behind clear technical documentation, validation evidence, and an operational runbook.

**Within Your First Six Months, You Will**

* Independently own production migration or integration workstreams from technical design through rollout and handoff.
* Deliver measurable improvements in migration turnaround time, validation quality, delivery cost, or regional FDE execution hours through reusable engineering.
* Help establish repeatable quality controls, code review practices, runbooks, and observability patterns for the India team.
* Demonstrate effective prioritization and communication across multiple concurrent APAC engagements.
* Turn at least one repeated delivery pattern into a reusable tool, component, or playbook that is adopted by a subsequent engagement.

Location:
  
  
This role is based in Hyderabad, India. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our Anchor Days, because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We're looking for someone who's excited to work alongside the team during those days.
  
  
By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy.
  
  
A Note on AI
  
  
You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.
  
  
Equal Opportunity & Accommodations
  
  
We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.
  
  
Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

title: Applied AI Platform Engineer-DATA ENGINEER - Software Specialist Engineer I
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Applied AI Platform Engineer I**
**Role Overview:**
As an Applied AI Platform Engineer I , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to building the platforms, tooling, accelerators, and frameworks that other engineering teams build on. Your expertise will be pivotal in delivering platform capabilities that delight the engineers who depend on them, while driving tangible leverage and value across Deloitte’s AI engineering investments. You will leverage your engineering craftsmanship across platform engineering, distributed systems, and modern AI/ML and Data infrastructure, consistently demonstrating your strong track record in delivering high-quality, reusable, outcome-focused solutions. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, build, and operate the enabling layer for AI engineering at scale.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for engineering-leverage and adoption outcomes. Build platform capabilities that solve recurring problems once, well, for many teams—reducing per-team build and operate toil while ensuring consistency and compliance by default through high-quality, lean designs and implementations.
* Serve as the technical advocate for the platform as a product, ensuring capability integrity, feasibility, and alignment with the needs of the engineering teams who consume it. Participate in requirement discovery with consuming teams, component design of platform services, frameworks, and the AI control plane, and their development, testing, integration, and support.
* Maintain accountability for the integrity of the platform architecture and for the enterprise tech-stack conformance baseline that engineering teams build against. Manage platform dependencies, code design, implementation, the data and policy-as-code enforcement layers, and the OpenTelemetry-based instrumentation substrate—building capabilities that are operable, instrumented, performant, and drift-resistant by design, to the production standards set by SRE. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, codify recurring patterns into reusable components and golden paths, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code to ensure all platform KPIs (adoption, reliability-by-design, and developer experience) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
* Develop lean platform capabilities through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve the real needs of consuming engineering teams. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right capability is delivered at the right time—and adopted, not shelved.
* Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering platform capabilities as lean, adoption-validated increments rather than big-bang builds, and keeping them supportable and maintainable.
* Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, SRE, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Integrate their constraints into the paved roads so that the secure, compliant, and reliable path is the easy path. Deliver capabilities that are admissible-by-design and submit them for admission, co-defining service-level objectives with SRE, who set production standards and own the admission decision. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.
* Possess expertise in platform engineering and modern AI/ML infrastructure—internal developer platforms, MLOps/LLMOps, model serving, retrieval and vector infrastructure, eval and observability tooling, policy-as-code, container orchestration, IaC, and CI/CD at platform scale—including AI and Agentic SSDLC to deliver self-service, governed capabilities with full automation from discovery to production to operations and all quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Learn to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize platform solutioning and delivery. Demonstrate understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.
* Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the enterprise data estate and the AI use-case patterns the platform must serve. Translate the needs of engineering teams, reference architectures, and governance requirements into reusable frameworks, the data platform, and governance-as-code enforcement. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.
* Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.
* Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.

**The team:**
US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.
  
  
**The successful candidate will possess:**

* Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.

**Required Qualifications:**

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor.
* 3+ years of software and platform engineering experience with most of the following: Angular, React, NodeJS, Python(Mandatory),, C#, .NET, Java, Rust, SQL/NoSQL, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LangFuse, Terraform, as well as unit, integration, and end-to-end testing frameworks & tools, specifically BDD, Gherkin, Cucumber, Playwright, and Selenium.
* 2+ years of experience designing, building, and operating AI/ML platform or infrastructure, with hands-on experience across building tooling for MLOps/LLMOps, model serving, retrieval and vector infrastructure, and eval/observability instrumentation for LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models).
* 2+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure, AWS, or GCP—including their AI/ML services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI—as well as container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), Big Data, Databricks, CI/CD at platform scale, and distributed systems.
* Prior experience with AI control-plane and agent-runtime patterns: model/LLM gateway, A2A and MCP integration, agent runtimes (e.g., Google ADK, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore), guardrails (PII redaction, prompt-injection, content, tool permissioning/tool-RBAC), policy-as-code, and multi-tenant isolation.
* Prior experience with enterprise data platform engineering: data pipelines, self-service and data-product enablement, governance-as-code enforcement, and metadata/lineage.
* Prior software engineering experience with the understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/entity relationship/data flow diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentations, and AI-augmented spec-driven development.
* Prior experience using methodologies & tools such as XP, Lean, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, and ArgoCD to deliver high-quality platforms and products rapidly.

**Other:**

* Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and products you build.
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. title: Director of Engineering, Data Platforms
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
13
  
  
We are seeking a strong technical and people leader to join as
**Director of Engineering, Data Platforms**
for our offshore team in India. In this role, you will partner closely with the core Databricks team to support the transition of existing data pipelines to the target platform, while continuing to refine, enhance, and operationalize those pipelines for scale, quality, reliability, and secure cloud-native delivery on AWS. AWS data engineering practices commonly emphasize automated and orchestrated data flows, metadata-driven pipelines, and alignment to platform guardrails and security controls.
  
  
This leader will manage a small, focused engineering team responsible for supporting offshore platform adoption and enabling asset-agnostic data onboarding into the enterprise data platform. The role is execution-oriented and collaborative in nature, with accountability for high-quality delivery, engineering rigor, and consistent partnership with global stakeholders.
  
  
You will also support integrations with the enterprise data mastering platform to help ensure trusted, standardized, and reusable data flows across the ecosystem. Experience with
**NeoXam DataHub**
is a strong plus, particularly in environments where master, market, reference, risk, and investment data are managed across the full lifecycle—from acquisition through distribution—to create a trusted single source of truth.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who combines hands-on data platform depth with practical team leadership, strong cross-geography collaboration, and experience establishing repeatable cloud data engineering patterns across modern lakehouse and mastering ecosystems.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Data Pipeline Transition and Platform Delivery
  
  

* Partner with the core Databricks team to plan and execute the transition of existing data pipelines to the target data platform.
* Lead the offshore team in enhancing, stabilizing, and optimizing pipelines after transition, with a focus on performance, scalability, maintainability, operational excellence, and secure AWS deployment patterns.
* Drive implementation of repeatable engineering patterns for ingestion, transformation, testing, deployment, and monitoring across onboarded datasets.
* Ensure pipelines are built and managed in a way that supports long-term platform consistency, reliability, observability, and ease of support.
* Guide the design and operation of cloud-native data pipelines leveraging relevant AWS services such as Amazon S3 for durable storage, AWS Glue for integration and catalog-driven processing, and AWS Lake Formation for governed data lake controls. AWS training and prescriptive guidance for data engineering emphasize building, optimizing, and securing solutions with these services.
* Promote the use of AWS IAM, encryption, and environment-level controls to enforce secure access to platform resources and data products in line with enterprise governance expectations. AWS guidance highlights alignment with architectural guardrails and security controls for data engineering platforms.

Data Onboarding and Asset-Agnostic Enablement
  
  

* Lead a small team responsible for supporting offshore teams with onboarding data to the enterprise platform in an asset-agnostic manner.
* Define and operationalize onboarding patterns that can support a broad range of data assets, domains, and source systems without requiring bespoke platform redesign for each use case.
* Work with partner teams to simplify and standardize how data is ingested, transformed, governed, and published to the platform.
* Help offshore teams adopt common onboarding frameworks, technical standards, and delivery practices that improve speed and reduce friction.
* Establish reusable ingestion and processing patterns across batch and streaming use cases using technologies such as AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, Amazon Kinesis, or event-driven integrations where appropriate to support scalable enterprise onboarding. AWS data engineering curricula and roadmap materials consistently position these services as core building blocks for modern cloud data engineering.

Data Mastering Platform Integration
  
  

* Support integration of platform pipelines and datasets with the enterprise data mastering platform.
* Collaborate with upstream and downstream stakeholders to ensure mastered data can be consumed reliably through standardized interfaces and governed data flows.
* Help establish data quality controls, reconciliation processes, metadata alignment, and stewardship workflows needed to support trusted mastered data in the platform.
* Contribute to issue resolution and continuous improvement related to mastering-related ingestion and distribution workflows.
* Support data mastering capabilities aligned with platforms such as NeoXam DataHub, including data acquisition, cleansing, enrichment, mastering, and downstream distribution of trusted data products. NeoXam positions DataHub as a configurable enterprise data management platform for the financial industry that manages the full lifecycle of master, market, risk, and investment data.
* Work with business and platform stakeholders to support golden record / golden copy generation and maintenance for key financial datasets, including reference data, instruments, business entities, and related mastered domains. NeoXam DataHub is specifically positioned to provide a single source of truth and has been used in financial services environments for enterprise-level golden copy data management.

Team Leadership and Delivery Management
  
  

* Lead, mentor, and develop a small team of data engineers supporting offshore onboarding and pipeline engineering.
* Set clear priorities, manage team execution, and ensure delivery commitments are met with quality and accountability.
* Provide day-to-day coaching, technical guidance, and performance feedback to team members.
* Foster a strong engineering culture centered on collaboration, continuous improvement, documentation, operational discipline, and measurable service ownership.
* Drive engineering rigor across sprint delivery, production readiness, support models, and incident management for business-critical data platforms.

Collaboration, Governance, and Engineering Standards
  
  

* Partner effectively with global platform, architecture, governance, and Databricks-aligned teams to ensure offshore delivery aligns with enterprise standards.
* Contribute to design reviews, implementation planning, and technical discussions related to pipeline architecture, onboarding patterns, cloud platform controls, and mastering integrations.
* Support governance requirements through appropriate controls around lineage, schema consistency, data quality, retention, and secure access.
* Promote adoption of engineering best practices including automated testing, CI/CD, observability, incident response, and production support readiness.
* Help establish cloud engineering standards for infrastructure as code, release automation, and environment promotion using tools and services such as AWS CodePipeline, AWS CodeBuild, and infrastructure automation frameworks where appropriate.
* Ensure monitoring and operational health practices are in place using logging, alerting, and telemetry patterns appropriate for enterprise data platforms, including AWS-native operational tooling where relevant.

**Required Qualifications**
Leadership and Delivery Experience

title: Applied AI Analyst II
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
  
  
The Applied AI Analyst II, Enabling Functions will help evolve Enabling Functions Analytics from static reporting toward intelligent, conversational, and reusable analytics products. The role combines practical AI research, context engineering, semantic modelling, and hands-on prototyping to connect governed enterprise data with large language models and modern analytics platforms. The individual will investigate how LLMs process context and generate responses, translate those learnings into reliable solution patterns, and build AI-enabled experiences using Claude, Databricks, Power BI, and related technologies. The role includes building text-to-SQL workflows, tool-using agents, and multi-agent systems that answer business questions reliably and transparently
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Apply working knowledge of concepts and procedures to a variety of analytics and AI assignments, using judgement to solve problems with a moderate level of guidance.
* Own well-defined research, experimentation, and prototyping workstreams, documenting assumptions, decisions, results, and limitations.
* Research and test LLM behaviours, reasoning patterns, context-window usage, tool use, structured outputs, and failure modes, and convert findings into practical design guidance and reusable patterns for analytics use cases.
* Design and optimise system instructions, business context, examples, metadata, retrieval strategies, and tool interfaces so AI responses are grounded, relevant, and consistent. Manage context quality, freshness, and token efficiency.
* Build text-to-SQL workflows that translate natural-language questions into governed queries, grounded in certified semantic models and metric definitions, with validation steps that check generated SQL before execution.
* Design tool-using agents that call approved functions and data services (such as SQL execution, metric lookup, and visualization generation) with clearly defined tool schemas, permissions, and fallback behaviour.
* Design and prototype multi-agent workflows in which specialist agents (for example, query planning, SQL generation, validation, and insight narration) coordinate under an orchestrator, with clear handoffs, state management, and loop and cost limits.
* Prototype chat-with-data and chat-with-document experiences that let users explore governed business information in natural language, while preserving traceability to approved data and metric definitions.
* Design and improve business-ready semantic models covering grain, dimensions, measures, relationships, hierarchies, synonyms, descriptions, and certified definitions, ensuring the same logic supports Power BI, Databricks, and AI experiences.
* Evaluate when to use prompting, retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, multi-agent workflows, or traditional analytics, and define fit-for-purpose architectures rather than applying LLMs where deterministic methods are more appropriate.
* Create test cases and evaluation datasets for SQL accuracy, tool-call correctness, agent task completion, groundedness, latency, and cost. Investigate hallucinations, retrieval or semantic failures, and agent loops, and recommend corrective actions.
* Build proof-of-value solutions using Python, SQL, APIs, Claude, and Databricks, integrating AI capabilities with existing analytics assets and, where appropriate, Power BI or lightweight application experiences.
* Break ambiguous business questions into clear problem statements, hypotheses, data needs, and solution options. Rapidly learn unfamiliar domains and communicate trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Document patterns, reusable components, guardrails, and lessons learned, and contribute to internal standards for context engineering, semantic models, LLM evaluation, and responsible AI adoption.
* Partner with business analysts, BI developers, data engineers, AI/ML specialists, architects, and governance teams to move successful prototypes toward sustainable products.
* Balance innovation with responsible AI, data governance, security, privacy, quality, and production-readiness expectations, including human-in-the-loop controls for consequential actions.

**Skills And Competencies**

* Strong analytical thinking, curiosity, and structured problem-solving, including comfort with ambiguous questions and incomplete information.
* Practical understanding of how large language models work, including tokenisation, embeddings, attention, context windows, inference, common failure modes, and the difference between model knowledge and supplied context.
* Hands-on expertise in prompt and context engineering, including instruction design, few-shot examples, grounding, retrieval-augmented generation, structured outputs, tool use, and context optimisation.
* Strong SQL workflow skills: writing and reviewing complex queries, designing text-to-SQL pipelines, enforcing read-only access and query guardrails, validating generated SQL against schema and metric definitions, and diagnosing incorrect joins, grain mismatches, and aggregation errors.
* Experience designing tool-using agents, including function and tool schema design, argument validation, error handling, retries, and permission boundaries.
* Working knowledge of multi-agent architectures such as orchestrator-worker, planner-executor, and specialist-agent patterns, including state management, handoffs between agents, termination conditions, and observability across agent steps.
* Hands-on experience with Anthropic Claude or comparable enterprise LLM platforms, including API-based integration, prompt orchestration, tool calling, and solution evaluation.
* Hands-on experience with Databricks, including notebooks, SQL Warehouses, governed data assets, and lakehouse-based analytics workflows. Exposure to Unity Catalog, AI/BI Genie, MLflow, or Mosaic AI is valuable.
* Experience designing and integrating REST APIs or equivalent service interfaces to connect LLMs, enterprise data platforms, and application experiences.
* Proficiency in Python and SQL for data exploration, AI prototyping, integration, evaluation, and automation.
* Experience with Git-based source control, branching, and pull-request practices, together with CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment
* Hands-on understanding of AWS deployment patterns for AI and analytics solutions, including environment configuration, security, logging, monitoring, and release processes is a plus
* Experience designing or consuming semantic models, with strong understanding of business metrics, dimensional modelling, relationships, grain, hierarchies, synonyms, and reusable business definitions.
* Experience with vector search, agent frameworks, Model Context Protocol, LLM observability, or automated evaluation methods.
* Ability to design experiments and evaluation datasets and assess groundedness, relevance, consistency, completeness, latency, and cost.
* Ability to present complex information to non-technical stakeholders in a clear and concise manner, and to create relevant and engaging PowerPoint presentations.
* Awareness of responsible AI, privacy, cybersecurity, data governance, access control, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate technical AI concepts into practical business implications and document reusable engineering patterns.
* Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

**Good to Have**

* Practical machine learning knowledge, including supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, model evaluation, and basic MLOps.
* Experience with Power BI, including semantic models, DAX, Power Query, row-level security, and integration of BI assets with AI-enabled analytics experiences.
* Familiarity with React or lightweight full-stack application development for creating user-facing AI experiences.
* Experience with agent orchestration frameworks and production monitoring of multi-agent systems.
* Experience working in regulated or highly governed enterprise environments.

**Experience**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering
* Approximately 3–5 years of relevant experience in analytics, data science, AI engineering, software engineering, or a closely related field. Strong applied project work may substitute for some formal experience.
* Demonstrated experience solving analytical problems using Python and SQL, including building or reviewing text-to-SQL or query-generation workflows.
* Demonstrated hands-on delivery involving Claude or a comparable LLM, tool-using agents or multi-agent workflows, Databricks, APIs, Git/CI/CD, and deployment of an AI-enabled analytics prototype.
* Experience working with stakeholders to translate a business question into a testable analytical or AI solution.
* Experience producing clear technical documentation and communicating analytical results using compelling oral and written storytelling.
* Ability to handle, and maintain the confidentiality of, highly sensitive information.

title: Senior AI Platform Engineer
description:
**Our Company**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
At Teradata, we're not just managing data; we're unleashing its full potential. Our Teradata AI Studio platform and pioneering Enterprise Vector Store are empowering the world's largest enterprises to derive unprecedented value from their most complex data. We're rapidly pushing the boundaries of what's possible with Artificial Intelligence, especially in the exciting realm of
**autonomous and agentic systems**
We’re building intelligent systems that go far beyond automation — they observe, reason, adapt, and drive complex decision-making across large-scale enterprise environments. As a member of our AI engineering team, you’ll play a critical role in designing and deploying advanced AI agents that integrate deeply with business operations, turning data into insight, action, and measurable outcomes.
  
  
In this role, you’ll architect foundational components for production-grade AI systems — from agent frameworks and LLM pipelines to observability and evaluation layers that ensure reliability, accountability, and performance. You’ll be responsible not just for building models, but for making them measurable, debuggable, and trustworthy in real-world, high-stakes deployments.
  
  
You’ll work alongside a high-caliber team of AI researchers, engineers, and data scientists tackling some of the hardest problems in AI and enterprise software — from scalable multi-agent coordination and fine-tuned LLM applications, to real-time monitoring, drift detection, and closed-loop retraining systems.
  
  
If you're passionate about building intelligent systems that are not only powerful but observable, resilient, and production-ready, this role offers the opportunity to shape the future of enterprise AI from the ground up.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and maintain robust backend microservices and APIs (REST, gRPC) to support Teradata AI Studio capabilities.
* Build, orchestrate, and deploy autonomous AI agents using frameworks like LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen.
* Implement tool calling, dynamic routing, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations for multi-agent workflows.
* Manage full application lifecycles, including application-level observability (e. g. , OpenTelemetry, Langfuse) and production incident resolution.
* Integrate and optimize stateful data layers, including vector databases and relational databases (e. g. , PostgreSQL) for agent memory and RAG pipelines.
* Implement AI-specific observability and tracing for LLM pipelines and multi-agent workflows to monitor performance, token usage, and response quality.

**Who You'll Work With**
Imagine collaborating daily with some of the brightest minds in the company – individuals who champion diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental to our success. You'll be part of a cohesive force, laser-focused on delivering high-quality, critical, and highly visible AI/ML functionality within the Teradata Cloud platform. Your insights will directly shape the future of our intelligent data solutions.
  
  
You'll report directly to the inspiring Sr. Manager, Software Engineering, who will champion your growth and empower your contributions.
  
  
**What Makes You A Qualified Candidate**

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field – your academic foundation is key.
* Core Programming: 3+ years of experience with any of the backend languages (Python, Go).
* Agent Frameworks: Hands-on experience building agents using frameworks like LangGraph, Langchain, CrewAI, etc. and integrating Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
* Direct experience building applications with LLM frameworks and multi-agent orchestration systems.
* Data Management: Direct experience managing relational databases (PostgreSQL) and Vector stores.
* API Design: 2+ years in building and managing REST or gRPC APIs and microservices for the application layer.

**What You'll Bring**

* Hands-on experience with LLM observability, tracing, and evaluation platforms (e. g. , Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, or OpenTelemetry for AI).
* Experience with LLM-specific tools and frameworks (LangChain, vector databases, prompt engineering).
* Experience with infrastructure security and compliance standards.
* Contributions to open-source projects or technical communities.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a collaborative team environment.
* Ownership mindset with a focus on reliability, scalability, and continuous improvement.

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
  
  
Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

description:

At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. LPL Financial is seeking a Data Product Analyst to support our Strategic Data Platforms, with a strong focus on how data is produced, shaped, governed, and delivered to downstream consumers across the firm.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of Product Management, Data Product Ownership, and Advanced Analysis, and is designed for a senior individual contributor who can bring rigor and clarity to complex, data‑centric platform initiatives.
  
  
The Data Product Analyst focuses on data as a product—helping define data contracts, validate quality, assess downstream impact, and support data product and platform decisions.
  
  
The ideal candidate is comfortable working across upstream systems of record, platform services, and downstream consumers, and excels at turning complex data flows into actionable insights and decisions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Product Discovery & Capability Support
  
  

* Support product discovery by helping translate business and platform needs into clear data‑centric problem statements.
* Contribute to roadmap planning by evaluating value, risk, and complexity across data initiatives.
* Help define outcomes and success measures for data platform capabilities (e.g., usability, reliability, adoption, quality).

Advanced Data Analysis & Problem Solving
  
  

* Perform hands‑on exploratory and diagnostic analysis across distributed data sources and platforms.
* Investigate data quality issues, lineage gaps, and semantic inconsistencies that affect downstream consumers.
* Conduct impact analysis for schema changes, new feeds, platform migrations, or system decommissions.
* Identify systemic issues in data flow, transformation, or consumption and recommend durable solutions.

Data Product Ownership (Supporting / Platform‑Level)
  
  

* Support Data Product Owners by helping define:
* Data contracts, schemas, and semantic definitions
* Data quality rules, validation logic, and controls
* Usage expectations and downstream dependencies
* Maintain traceability between business intent, data products, and technical implementation.
* Partner with engineering, architecture, and data platform teams to support scalable, reusable distribution patterns.

Agile Execution & Delivery
  
  

* Contribute to Jira artifacts (features, stories, acceptance criteria) with strong data and platform context.
* Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, and demos to ensure work reflects validated platform and consumer needs.
* Support prioritization decisions by providing evidence‑based impact and dependency analysis.

Stakeholder Communication & Influence
  
  

* Act as an analytical partner to Product Managers, Platform Owners, Engineering, and downstream consumer teams.
* Communicate complex data flow and platform concepts in clear, decision‑ready narratives.
* Help align stakeholders across domains by grounding conversations in data realities and trade‑offs.

**What are we looking for?**
We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates
**pursue greatness**
,
**act with integrity**
, and are
**driven to help our clients succeed**
. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we
**win together**
and
**create and share joy**
in our work.
  
  
**Requirements**

* 4+ years of experience in Product Analytics, Data Analysis, Data Product Ownership, or Platform‑oriented Product roles.
* Strong hands‑on experience with SQL (advanced querying, joins, performance awareness)
* Experience working with data platforms, distributed data systems, or integration layers.
* Experience adopting emerging AI‑enabled capabilities to improve the speed, depth, and effectiveness of data analysis
* Experience operating in Agile/Scrum environments with cross‑functional product and engineering teams.
* Proven ability to work across ambiguity and translate complex data ecosystems into actionable insights.
* Solid understanding of:
* Data modeling and semantic consistency
* Data quality, lineage, and governance concepts
* Pipelines, and event‑driven architectures (conceptual and analytical understanding)

**Preferences**

* Experience supporting advisor data platforms, or shared enterprise data services.
* Background in financial services, wealth management, or other highly regulated data environments.

**Core Competencies**

* Familiarity with downstream consumer needs (applications, analytics platforms, partners, regulatory consumers).
* Experience performing impact analysis for data changes across multiple consuming systems.

title: Sr. Specialist, Data Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
**The Opportunity**

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Data Engineer, you will design, build and maintain scalable data pipelines and platforms and ensure pipeline reliability, performance and governance through automation, monitoring, logging and documentation. You will partner with data scientists, analysts and business stakeholders to translate requirements into production-grade, observable pipelines and datasets. You will operate within a matrix environment, participating in project planning, delivery and cross-team collaboration.
  
  
**What Will You Do In This Role**

* Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines to extract data from various sources and populate a data lake and data warehouse.
* Work closely with data scientists, analysts, and business teams to understand data requirements and deliver solutions aligned with business goals.
* Build and maintain platforms that support data ingestion, transformation, and orchestration across various data sources, both internal and external.
* Use data orchestration, logging, and monitoring tools to build resilient pipelines.
* Automate data flows and pipeline monitoring to ensure scalability, performance, and resilience of the platform.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve issues related to the data integration platform, ensuring uptime and reliability.
* Maintain thorough documentation for integration processes, configurations, and code to ensure easy onboarding for new team members and future scalability.
* Develop pipelines to ingest data into cloud data warehouses.
* Create and deliver standard reports in accordance with stakeholder needs.
* Work within a matrix organizational structure, reporting to both the functional manager and the project manager.
* Participate in project planning, execution, and delivery, ensuring alignment with both functional and project goals.

**What Should You Have**
**Primary**
(Python, SQL, PySpark, AWS, Apache Spark, Databricks, cloud object storage, ci/cd, ETL, data modelling)
  
  

* Bachelors’ degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or any Technology stream.
* 7-11 years of experience in developing data pipelines & data infrastructure, ideally within a drug development or life sciences context.
* Strong SQL skills and solid programming experience in Python (including PySpark)
* Practical experience with AWS S3 and core AWS console concepts (IAM, regions, basic cloud architecture)
* Hands-on experience with Apache Spark (concepts and usage) and Databricks (platform use, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog)
* Experience with cloud object storage (e.g., Amazon S3) and cloud data warehouses or lakehouses (e.g., Redshift, Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Delta Lake)
* Familiarity with data modeling, ETL/ELT patterns, and data transformation best practices
* Experience implementing monitoring, logging, and data quality checks for operational pipelines
* Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and pipelines for data deployments, experience with Git-based tooling (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps)
* Proven ability to work collaboratively with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders
* Good interpersonal and communication skills (verbal and written)
* Product and customer-centric approach and innovative thinking

**Secondary skills (nice to have)**
(Experience with AI Assisted code development, GitHub Copilot, people management, and team lead experience)
  
  

* Prior experience in a global or matrixed organization
* Exposure to observability and data quality platforms (Monte Carlo, Great Expectations, Deequ)
* Knowledge of orchestration and scheduling tools (Airflow, Prefect, Azure Data Factory)

**Who We Are**
We are known as Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
  
  
**What We Look For**
Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.
  
  
**Additional location(s) Compensation Information**
**Required Skills**
Amazon Web Services (AWS), Apache Spark, CI/CD, Cloud Software, Databricks Platform, Data ETL, Data Modeling, PySpark, Python (Programming Language), Structured Query Language (SQL)
  
  
**Preferred Skills**
GitHub, Microsoft Copilot, People Management

title: AI Tech lead
description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

The AI Tech Lead serves as a key technical resource for the ZenAI platform and a critical escalation point for complex platform, integration, and engineering issues. The role requires deep platform expertise and is responsible for feature evaluation, advanced technical consulting, and development of the internal tools on which the team depends. The AI Tech Lead ensures that solutions deployed on ZenAI are optimized for performance, cost efficiency, and model selection; advises power users and technical audiences on advanced platform capabilities; and serves as the technical liaison to vendor engineering and support teams. This role will initially operate as an individual contributor and is expected to evolve into a people-leadership position with one to three direct reports as the team grows. The role also provides complementary coverage across time zones in partnership with the global AI Capabilities & Governance team.

**POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Master Data and Capacity Model Ownership:**
  Own the capacity model and related planning master data in SAP IBP. Use the master data dashboard to identify gaps or inaccuracies in production run rates, changeover constraints, material lead times, resource calendars and other planning parameters. Coordinate corrections with the relevant supply planners and master data stewards responsible for maintaining the source data in ECC/S/4HANA.

* **Constraint Identification and Alert Generation:**
  Run SAP IBP heuristics and planning algorithms to identify constraints across the supply network. Generate system alerts for capacity bottlenecks, material shortages, safety stock violations, and demand-supply imbalances.

* **Scenario Building:**
  Build comparable scenarios with consistent assumptions that enable the Supply Planers in both the Mid-Term and Short-Term to evaluate alternatives. Ensure scenarios are structured, repeatable, and documented so that leadership can compare options on a level playing field.

* **Resolution Modelling:**
  Execute resolution modelling in SAP S4 ePPDS and SAP IBP to test proposed solutions before they are committed. Validate feasibility of allocation changes, schedule adjustments, and capacity rebalancing options.

* **Digital Twin Development:**
  Drive digital twin development as organizational maturity evolves. Progress the modelling capability through maturity stages: heuristic-based planning, optimizer-driven planning, and ultimately AI/Joule-enabled autonomous planning.

* **Data and Parameter Stewardship:**
  Serve as the owner of planning parameters, ensuring that safety stock targets, lot sizes, planning horizons, and aggregation rules are correctly configured and regularly reviewed for accuracy. Ensure issues identified through modelling or business plan validation are escalated and corrected at source where required.

**RESOURCES MANAGED**

***Financial Accountability***

None.

***Supervision***

Initially an individual contributor role. Expected to supervise one to three ZICC-based direct reports (AI Tech Analysts) over time as the team grows.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

The following education and experience qualifications are required or preferred:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field required; advanced degree preferred
* 8+ years of professional experience in technical roles such as software engineering, platform engineering, or solution architecture

* Experience building internal tooling, dashboards, and automation solutions
* Prior people leadership or team lead experience preferred
* Experience in the pharmaceutical, life sciences, or regulated industry preferred

* Deep expertise with enterprise AI platforms and technologies, including agents, workflows, skills, integrations, and agentic AI; experience with Langdock, OpenAI, or similar platforms preferred.

* Strong proficiency in Python and scripting languages for automation and tooling
* Experience with Databricks preferred
* Proficiency with database technologies (SQL Server, PostgreSQL) and reporting frameworks
* Understanding of FinOps principles, token/cost tracking, and spend optimization
* Experience with AI-assisted coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, GPT Codex, or similar)
* Experience with Flask, Posit/RStudio, or similar application development frameworks
* Proficiency with collaboration tools (Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, Confluence)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

description:
**What you will do on your journey with WebBeds.**

As an SAP Consultant Lead / SAP ABAP Developer Lead, you will join the growing global SAP team at WebBeds and play a key role in our SAP S/4HANA and RISE with SAP transformation journey.

**\***
These roles are based in Hyderabad and can also be considered in Bangalore, Pune, Chennai or Noida. We are building an internal SAP capability to drive innovation, reduce reliance on external partners and establish long-term ownership of our business processes and SAP solutions.'

We are recruiting across multiple functional and technical domains, with opportunities for SAP R2R, O2C, P2P & FP&A, together with an SAP ABAP Developer Lead.

Each successful candidate will lead delivery and solution ownership within their area of expertise. Functional Leads will collaborate with Finance, Procurement, Commercial and Operations teams to translate business requirements into scalable SAP solutions, while the SAP ABAP Developer Lead will partner with Functional Leads, Global Process Owners and technical teams to deliver Clean Core-aligned developments, integrations, analytics and automation.

All roles will contribute to process standardisation, innovation, compliance, operational excellence and measurable business value.

**In this role you will:**

**Key responsibilities**

* **End-to-end delivery:**
  lead delivery within your assigned functional domain or ABAP technical specialism, from requirements and solution design through testing, deployment, go-live, hypercare and operational handover.
* **Stakeholder partnership:**
  partner with business stakeholders, Global Process Owners, SAP teams, integration teams and delivery partners to define scalable future-state solutions.
* **SAP best practice:**
  champion SAP S/4HANA best practices, RISE with SAP, fit-to-standard delivery and Clean Core principles.
* **Design, testing and deployment:**
  lead or support workshops, fit-gap analysis, solution design, documentation, SIT, UAT, end-to-end testing, data migration, cutover and production readiness.
* **Automation and governance:**
  drive automation, process standardisation, continuous improvement, controls, compliance and governance.
* **Innovation:**
  identify opportunities to apply SAP Signavio, SAP Business AI, Joule, SAP BTP, SAP Build, Datasphere, SAC, Cloud ALM and LeanIX where relevant to your role (nice to have).
* **Specialist leadership:**
  provide leadership within your specialist area through design assurance, quality oversight, knowledge transfer and effective collaboration with internal and external teams.
* **Record-to-Report (R2R) Functional Consultant Lead:**
  own end-to-end R2R processes within SAP S/4HANA, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Intercompany Accounting, Tax, Financial Close, Statutory and Management Reporting, Profitability Analysis (CO-PA), Bank Reconciliations and Finance Controls, and partner with O2C and P2P process owners to support an integrated Finance operating model across the WebBeds SAP landscape.
* **Order-to-Cash (O2C) Functional Consultant Lead:**
  own end-to-end O2C processes within SAP S/4HANA, including Customer Master Data, Sales Order Management, Pricing, Billing and Invoicing, Accounts Receivable, Credit Management, Collections, Dispute Management, Cash Application, Revenue Management and customer experience optimisation, and lead the design, configuration, standardisation and continuous improvement of SAP SD and FSCM capabilities to strengthen revenue assurance, working capital, collections effectiveness and operational efficiency.

  own planning and performance management processes, including budgeting, rolling forecasts, scenario modelling, cost and profit centre planning, allocations, profitability analysis, business performance analysis, management reporting, dashboards, planning standardisation, SAC Planning, Datasphere and decision-support insights.
* **SAP ABAP Developer Lead:**
  own the technical design and delivery of SAP ABAP and BTP solutions across R2R, O2C, P2P & FP&A, translating functional requirements into scalable RICEFW objects, custom transactions, reports, interfaces, forms, workflows, CDS-based data models, APIs, integrations, Fiori services and intelligent automation solutions aligned with Clean Core principles.

**The skills we would love to see in your suitcase!**

* Proven experience in at least one of the functional domains (R2R, O2C, P2P, FP&A) or in SAP ABAP development, with relevant professional experience, technical expertise and business process knowledge.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, strong hands-on SAP ABAP experience in S/4HANA, including ABAP Objects, Data Dictionary, ALV, Smart Forms or Adobe Forms, enhancements, BAdIs, user exits and performance optimisation.

* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, advanced experience with ABAP CDS Views, including data models, analytical queries and consumption views supporting Fiori, Datasphere, SAC and Finance reporting.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, experience with RAP, OData services, APIs, SAP Gateway, Fiori/UI5 extensibility and SAP BTP or side-by-side extension patterns.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, exposure to SAP Business AI, Joule, SAP Build, AI-assisted development, workflow automation or agentic automation is strongly preferred (nice to have).
