title: Junior Data Engineer
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
  
  
**Job Description:**
Job Description: Data Engineer – Microsoft Stack
  
  
**Experience Level:**
0–2 years
  
  
Title: Junior Data Engineer
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
We are looking for an enthusiastic and detail-oriented Data Engineer with 0–2 years of experience to support the design, development, and maintenance of data solutions using the Microsoft technology stack. The candidate will work with data platforms, pipelines, databases, and analytics teams to help transform raw data into reliable, secure, and business-ready datasets.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Assist in building, testing, and maintaining data pipelines using Microsoft Azure services such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, or related tools.
* Support data ingestion, transformation, cleansing, and loading activities from structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data sources.
* Work with SQL Server, Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Lake Storage, and other Microsoft data platforms to store, process, and manage data.
* Write and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, and basic data transformation scripts.
* Collaborate with data analysts, BI developers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver reliable datasets.
* Assist in implementing data quality checks, validation rules, monitoring, and troubleshooting of data pipelines.
* Support reporting and analytics initiatives using Power BI datasets, semantic models, or data marts as required.
* Follow data security, access control, governance, and compliance standards while handling enterprise data.
* Document data flows, pipeline logic, data mappings, and technical specifications.
* Continuously learn and apply best practices in cloud data engineering, automation, performance optimization, and modern data architecture.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Basic to intermediate knowledge of SQL, relational databases, and database design concepts.
* Hands-on academic, internship, project, or work exposure to Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL Database, or equivalent relational database platforms.
* Understanding of ETL/ELT concepts, data pipelines, data warehousing, data lakes, and data modeling fundamentals.
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Azure data services such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric.
* Exposure to Python, PySpark, or scripting for data processing is preferred.
* Basic understanding of Power BI, semantic models, dashboards, and reporting concepts is an added advantage.
* Awareness of data security, role-based access control, encryption, data privacy, and governance concepts.
* Familiarity with Git, Azure DevOps, CI/CD concepts, or Agile delivery practices is preferred.

Qualification Requirements
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Software Engineering, Electronics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical discipline.
* 0–2 years of relevant experience in data engineering, database development, cloud data platforms, BI engineering, or analytics engineering.
* Fresh graduates may be considered if they have completed relevant academic projects, internships, capstone projects, or hands-on training in Microsoft data technologies.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and logical reasoning skills.
* Ability to understand business requirements and convert them into technical data solutions under guidance.
* Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
* Willingness to learn Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, data engineering best practices, and modern cloud analytics platforms.

Good to have Certification Requirements
  
  
The candidate must have at least one relevant Microsoft certification or Training completed before joining or within the hiring eligibility window defined by the organization.
  
  

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900) or Data Engineer related training certification.
* Preferred for consideration: Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600), Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate, or equivalent Microsoft data engineering certification aligned to current Microsoft certification paths.
* Additional advantage: Power BI Data Analyst Associate certification or hands-on Microsoft Learn achievements related to Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, Azure SQL, or Power BI.

**Preferred Attributes**

* Curiosity to learn new data technologies and apply them in real-world business scenarios.
* Attention to detail in data validation, documentation, and quality checks.
* Ability to work with large datasets and troubleshoot data-related issues.

description:

**Data Engineer/Developer**
**Role Summary**
Design, build, and optimize Azure data pipelines and lakehouse solutions. Deliver secure, reliable datasets with strong governance, automation, and documentation. Collaborate across teams and contribute to standards in an Agile setting.
  
  
**Must-Have (Day 1)**

* Experience: 4–6 years in data engineering
* Core Platform: Databricks with Python, Spark, Pandas (notebooks and modular code)
* Orchestration: Azure Data Factory (pipelines, integration runtimes); ingest from diverse sources
* Lakehouse: Delta Lake fundamentals; Medallion architecture (bronze/silver/gold) in production
* Storage/SQL/Performance: Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS); strong SQL; performance-aware design
* Data Patterns: ETL/ELT; data modeling (e.g., dimensional/star schema)
* DevOps & Security: CI/CD for data projects (Azure DevOps or GitHub Enterprise); familiarity with Azure Entra ID for SSO/RBAC; secure workspace/data access
* Quality & Observability: Data validation/testing, code reviews, and basic monitoring/alerting for jobs/pipelines
* Ways of Working: Agile/Scrum (Jira/Confluence); clear pipeline and data contract documentation
* Collaboration: Effective stakeholder engagement; support/mentor junior team members; clear communication
* Generative AI (Day 1):

+ Prompt design for data tasks (ingestion, transformations, documentation) with clear objectives and constraints
+ Use of Copilot/ChatGPT to scaffold notebooks/jobs, generate tests, and optimize SQL/Spark—validates outputs before merging

* Unity Catalog migration (Hive to Unity) and permissions/governance
* Databricks DevOps (cluster configuration, secret management, workspace automation)
* Azure Functions (C# or Python) for orchestration/integration
* Synapse dedicated SQL pools or dbt; Delta Live Tables
* Financial services domain exposure

* Work independently with minimal supervision while contributing to team outcomes
* Commitment to secure practices and production-grade reliability
* Continuous improvement mindset and willingness to learn new tools/technologies
* Willingness to work within regulated environment controls and policies

title: Senior Data Engineer-1
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Data Engineer-1
  
  
Who is Mastercard?
  
  
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  
  
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard is seeking a Senior Data Engineer to join our team in Hyderabad, India. This is an experienced individual-contributor role that owns end-to-end pipeline delivery and mentors peers. It will appeal to you if you combine deep technical expertise with the ability to independently deliver complex data solutions and raise the bar for the engineers around you.
  
  
You will bring cutting edge software and full stack development skills with advanced knowledge of cloud and data lake experience while working with massive data volumes. Our teams are small, agile, and focused on the needs of the high growth fintech marketplace, and you will work across functional teams within Mastercard to deliver on our cloud strategy while keeping our systems resilient, responsive, and maintainable on cloud.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Own the end-to-end design, development, and delivery of complex batch and real-time data pipelines using Databricks, Spark, Python, and PySpark.
  
  
Drive dbt-based transformation architecture with rigorous Test-Driven Development (TDD) and modular design.
  
  
Design and own CI/CD pipelines using GitLab and Jenkins, and champion DataOps practices across the team.
  
  
Administer and optimize Databricks objects and the platform using Databricks Asset Bundles, managing performance, access, and cost.
  
  
Establish data observability frameworks covering quality, freshness, lineage, and anomaly detection.
  
  
Lead the design of real-time data streaming pipelines (e.g., using Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming).
  
  
Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, and lead code and design reviews.
  
  
Partner with stakeholders on requirements, delivery planning, and technical trade-offs.
  
  
Plan and execute deployments, migrations, and upgrades with minimal disruption to operations.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical field (Master's a plus).
  
  
5+ years of data engineering experience.
  
  
Deep hands-on experience with Databricks (including administration), Spark, and Python.
  
  
Strong background in PySpark and distributed data processing.
  
  
Proven track record using dbt for robust, testable transformation workflows following TDD.
  
  
Familiarity with Databricks Asset Bundles for object deployment and version control.
  
  
Strong CI/CD (GitLab, Jenkins) and DataOps expertise.
  
  
Experience with real-time data processing and streaming pipelines.
  
  
Expert SQL development and strong cloud infrastructure experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  
  
Demonstrated experience mentoring engineers and leading technical delivery.
  
  
Ideally you have experience in banking, e-commerce, credit cards or payment processing and exposure to both SaaS and premises-based architectures. In addition, you have a post-secondary degree in computer science, mathematics, or quantitative science.
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description:
**Lead Data Engineer (OIC)**

* 1804, 18th Floor, Gowra Palladium, Hyderabad, India
* Full-time
* Location India - Hyderabad
* Company Mattel Global Business Services

**Company Description**
**CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER.**
It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire fans, entertain audiences and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are seeking an experienced
**Data Engineer/Lead Data Engineer/Data Engineering Specialist for Oracle + GCP**
to design, build, and optimize scalable, high-performance data platforms. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in
**ETL/ELT frameworks,**
OIC, and
**Google Cloud Platform (GCP),**
and will work closely with business and technical teams to deliver reliable, secure, and analytics-ready data solutions.
  
  
A typical day for a Data Engineer involves a mix of technical and collaborative tasks. The main responsibilities include
  
  

* Integration Development Designing and building integrations using OIC's visual interface. This involves configuring connections, defining data mappings, and orchestrating complex business processes.
* API Management Creating, managing, and optimizing APIs (Application Programming Interfaces) to facilitate secure and reliable data exchange.
* Troubleshooting and Support Monitoring integration performance, identifying and resolving technical issues, and providing ongoing support for deployed integrations to ensure data integrity.
* Collaboration Working with business analysts and architects to gather requirements, translating them into technical specifications, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver effective solutions.
* Documentation Maintaining comprehensive documentation of all integration designs, processes, and workflows for future reference and maintenance.
* Best Practices Adhering to industry standards and best practices for integration development and security.
* Implement data validation, data cleansing, and data quality controls to ensure accurate and reliable datasets.

**Qualifications**
Technical Skills
  
  

* Proven experience with OIC Hands-on experience developing integrations is essential.
* Strong Data Modeling skills (conceptual, logical, physical)
* Proficiency in SQL and Python
* Experience with Google BigQuery (GBQ) or Oracle 23ai
* Experience with Apache Airflow / GCP Cloud Composer / OCP Scheduler
* Database skills Familiarity with SQL and PL/SQL.
* Deployment and testing Experience with the full software development lifecycle, including testing and deployment processes.

**Qualifications And Soft Skills**

* 10-13 years of experience is required.
* Proficiency in Oracle Database (SQL, PL/SQL) and related tools (e.g., SQL Developer).
* Strong knowledge of at least one of the Oracle ERP module, i.e. Financials, Procurement, Inventory, Order Management.
* Knowledge of cloud technologies and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) or Oracle Goldengate is a plus.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to address complex business and technical challenges.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Detail-oriented with a focus on delivering high-quality, error-free solutions.
* Problem-Solving  Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a proactive approach to addressing challenges.
* Cultural Awareness  Ability to work effectively in a multicultural environment and manage teams across different time zones.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Oracle certifications, i.e. Oracle Certified Professional (OCP)
* Knowledge of DevOps practices, including version control (e.g., Git), CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
* Familiarity with Agile or Scrum project management methodologies.
* Familiarity with OpenAI prompt engineering and Machine Learning / LLM concepts
* Knowledge of DBT

**Additional Information**
Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Data Engineering SMTS/LMTS
description:
**Description**
About Salesforce
  
  
We’re Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI+ Data +CRM. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good– you’ve come to the right place.
  
  
**Department Overview**
The Revenue Analytics team builds the data platforms, intelligent products, modern application capabilities, and AI-enabled automation that power enterprise decision-making. We combine deep engineering expertise with business context to deliver trusted, scalable systems that support both human and agent-driven workflows.
  
  
Our team partners with business and technology leaders to solve complex challenges through modern data architecture, governed data products, integrated app services, and agentic systems. We emphasize production reliability, measurable business value, and responsible automation—not experimentation without operational accountability.
  
  
**Role Description: Hands On Data Lead & Systems Integrator**
We are seeking a
**Lead Member of Technical Staff (LMTS)**
to serve as a primary technical execution lead across our core data platform and its application integration interfaces.
  
  
This is a hands-on technical leadership role. While operating within the overarching platform architecture established by Principal Engineers, you will own the delivery of high-impact data engineering projects, build resilient pipelines, and ensure data products seamlessly plug into downstream applications, web tools, and agentic workflows. You will bring deep expertise in core data engineering (Python, Snowflake, dbt, SQL) complemented by solid working knowledge of the app development ecosystem (Node.js, APIs, microservices) to bridge data platforms with full-stack systems. You will lead project-level execution, mentor senior engineers, and translate complex requirements into production-ready software.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**

* Data Engineering Project Leadership & Execution: Lead the design, execution, and optimization of end-to-end data pipelines for batch and event-driven workloads. Own project-level technical delivery, write high-performance production code, and guide team members to deliver scalable data products on schedule.
* Data Platform & Product Design: Define patterns for data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and storage using Python, SQL, dbt, Snowflake, and Airflow. Establish standards for data contracts, semantic consistency, lineage, and reusable data assets to support both business analytics and AI applications.
* App Ecosystem & Integration Layering: Design and maintain lightweight API integration components, Node.js services, and middleware that expose data platform capabilities to full-stack applications, web dashboards, and external enterprise platforms (Salesforce, AWS).
* Agentic Architecture & Tool Integration: Implement enterprise-controlled agentic capabilities and AI-enabled workflows. Integrate autonomous agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers into application endpoints and data pipelines, ensuring structured outputs, context retrieval, and clear human-agent handoffs.
* Verification & Production Reliability: Establish testing strategies, CI/CD pipelines, performance tuning, and operational observability across both data pipelines and app integration services. Define and enforce SLOs/SLAs for pipeline availability, data freshness, and API endpoint performance.
* Cross-Team Leadership & Quality Standards: Conduct code and design reviews. Mentor Senior and Associate Engineers, championing engineering standards for clean code, automated testing, and documentation across both data and application interfaces.

**Technical Profile**

* Core Data Engineering Foundations:
* Deep expertise in Python and advanced SQL, with a strong background in operating production data platforms.
* Extensive experience with data stack technologies: dbt, Apache Airflow, Apache Spark, and Snowflake (including query optimization, performance tuning, cost management, and complex troubleshooting).
* Command of distributed systems, dimensional/domain-oriented data modeling, batch/streaming patterns, and Data Mesh / data-as-a-product concepts.
* Application Ecosystem & Integration Knowledge:
* Practical experience with Node.js and TypeScript / JavaScript for building lightweight backend services, microservices, or integration layers.
* Hands-on knowledge of designing and consuming REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, and event queues (Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS).
* Understanding of web app integration patterns, API gateways, and enterprise authentication protocols (OAuth2, SSO).
* AI & Agentic Engineering:
* Practical experience building or integrating AI-enabled workflows using frameworks like LangGraph or LangChain.
* Working knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, structured outputs, context engineering, vector stores, and retrieval mechanisms.
* Effective use of AI-native developer tools (e.g., Cursor, Codex, Claude Code) with rigorous review and testing of generated code.
* Cloud & DevOps Infrastructure:
* Hands-on experience operating on cloud platforms, preferably AWS.
* Familiarity with Docker, container orchestration (Kubernetes/ECS), serverless deployment (Lambda), CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).

**Qualifications**

* Experience: Typically 10 to 14+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or Platform Engineering (or equivalent demonstrated technical depth).
* Execution Leadership: Proven track record of leading complex data projects from requirements through architecture, deployment, and ongoing operation.
* Hybrid Systems Knowledge: Ability to serve as the bridge between core data platform engineering (Python/SQL/Snowflake) and web application developer teams (Node.js/APIs).
* Business & Communication Skills: Ability to translate technical implementation choices into business outcomes, work closely with product managers, and communicate effectively across engineering teams.

description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
We are looking for an experienced Architect to lead enterprise architecture for knowledge and data engineering, RAG, and Graph RAG. Experience in Agentic AI, orchestration, testing, evaluation, and governance is desirable. Working with architecture, data, AI, security, risk, product, testing, and application teams, you will turn business strategy into practical architectures, standards, roadmaps, and delivery controls. You will bring strong architectural leadership and expertise in semantic technologies, modern data platforms, and retrieval systems.
  
  
**Why this role is important to us**
Enterprise AI depends on trusted, well-engineered, permission-aware, traceable, and continuously validated data and knowledge. This role establishes the architectural foundation that connects source systems, data pipelines, semantic models, knowledge graphs, retrieval services, models, agents, controls, testing, and business workflows. The Architect will reduce fragmented point solutions, promote reusable capabilities, guide investment decisions, and ensure that AI applications and agents retrieve reliable evidence, generate grounded responses, execute approved actions, and remain secure, observable, auditable, resilient, and compliant throughout their lifecycle.
  
  
**About The Team — Alpha Intelligence**
Alpha Intelligence is State Street’s AI & Automation Center of Excellence for Alpha Implementations — the team rewiring how the industry’s first front-to-back platform gets delivered. We turn the deep expertise locked inside our implementation teams into engineered processes, governed knowledge and intelligent agents that cut manual effort, compress client go-live timelines and make every implementation faster and more predictable than the last.
  
  
We operate as one global team across the North America, EMEA, and APAC, combining process engineering, automation delivery, AI platform engineering and responsible-AI governance under a single roof. We work on real client implementations, not pilots that sit on a shelf — what we build is adopted, measured and scaled. If you want to shape how AI is applied to one of the most complex delivery landscapes in financial services, this is the team to do it in.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
Own the enterprise architecture for Knowledge Engineering, Data Engineering, RAG and Graph RAG, Agentic AI, testing, and governance, aligning strategy, platforms, delivery, controls, and measurable outcomes.
  
  

* Define the enterprise vision, target architecture, standards, reusable patterns, and roadmap across data, knowledge, retrieval, AI agents, testing, and governance.
* Translate business priorities into scalable solution architectures, transition plans, investment decisions, and measurable outcomes.
* Lead knowledge and data architecture, including ontologies, semantic models, knowledge graphs, metadata, lineage, data pipelines, quality, and lifecycle management.
* Architect production-grade RAG and Graph RAG services covering ingestion, indexing, hybrid retrieval, ranking, grounding, citations, provenance, and feedback.
* Establish testing, evaluation, and release standards for data quality, retrieval, prompts.
* Embed testing, monitoring, traceability, rollback, and governance controls in delivery pipelines.
* Lead architecture reviews, align stakeholders, and guide technical teams.

**What We Value**
The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking, enterprise architecture perspective, deep technical credibility, and a quality-and-risk mindset. The candidate must communicate complex architectural choices, test evidence, control requirements, risks, and trade-offs clearly to engineering teams, business stakeholders, governance forums, auditors, and senior technology leaders. We value pragmatic architecture, business-value alignment, secure-by-design and test-by-design practices, reuse, interoperability, measurable quality, transparent decision making, and continuously governed enterprise AI outcomes.
  
  
These skills will help you succeed in this role
  
  
**Must-have Skills**

* Strong experience in enterprise architecture, technical leadership, and working with cross-functional teams.
* Strong data engineering expertise across ETL/ELT, batch and streaming pipelines, lakehouse or warehouse platforms, data quality, and DataOps.
* Expertise in designing ontologies and semantic models and implementing end-to-end RAG and Graph RAG pipelines, including ingestion, chunking, embeddings, indexing, hybrid retrieval, semantic search, graph traversal, ranking, grounding, provenance, and evaluation.
* Strong knowledge of Responsible AI, privacy, access control, model risk, auditability, regulatory compliance, and policy enforcement.
* Experience delivering solutions in financial services or another regulated industry.

**Nice-to-have Skills**

* Exposure to modern data, streaming, workflow, monitoring, vector database, and enterprise search tools such as Snowflake, Databricks, Kafka, dbt, or Airflow would be useful.
* Familiarity with AI platforms or frameworks such as Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Vertex AI, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or MLflow would be beneficial.
* Awareness of Model Context Protocol, connecting AI agents with tools, access controls, monitoring, and AI security would be helpful.
* Experience establishing automated testing, quality gates, monitoring, traceability, release, and rollback controls within CI/CD and MLOps/LLMOps.
* An understanding of cloud costs, capacity planning, and communicating architecture proposals to senior stakeholders would be useful.
* Relevant certifications in architecture, cloud, data, graph, testing, security, governance, or Generative AI would be a plus.

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field is preferred; a master’s degree would be a plus.
* Extensive technology experience, ideally including architecture, data or knowledge engineering, software or AI engineering, testing, governance, or enterprise platforms.
* Experience providing architectural guidance and contributing to standards, roadmaps, governance, and key design decisions would be valuable.
* Exposure to delivering secure, scalable, and well-governed data platforms, knowledge graphs, ontologies, RAG or Graph RAG services, Agentic AI, or Generative AI solutions would be beneficial.
* The ability to work with senior stakeholders and bring business, architecture, engineering, testing, cloud, security, risk, and operations teams together would be helpful.
* Relevant certifications in architecture, cloud, data, graph, testing, security, governance, or Generative AI would be a plus.

**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Azure AI/BI and agentic solution design and delivery
  
  

* Design, build and productionise AI/BI and generative AI solutions on Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric and Microsoft Foundry, including natural-language analytics (for example, Fabric data agents and Copilot in Power BI).

Microsoft Data & AI partnership
  
  

* Own Mivada's Microsoft Data & AI partner relationship and partner-tier roadmap, including the Solutions Partner for Data & AI (Azure) designation and relevant specialisations.
* Lead Microsoft co-sell, joint go-to-market and partner-funded programs (for example, workshops, assessments and proofs of concept) together with the Pre-Sales, Propositions & Industry Engagement lead.
* Build and maintain certified Microsoft Data & AI capability across the practice, including own hands-on delivery.
* Represent Mivada at Microsoft partner forums and build relationships with Microsoft partner development managers and solution specialists.

Internal AI enablement and capability uplift
  
  

* Build and maintain the reusable prompt/playbook library and templated workflows that move staff from ad hoc use (L1/L2) toward governed, team-level and client-facing use (L3+) on the practice's AI maturity scale.
* Recruit, train and coordinate the peer-coach network; deliver the role-based training tiers, including Responsible AI and AI literacy for all staff; track adoption, confidence and training completion each quarter.

Client and stakeholder engagement
  
  

* Partner with the Pre-Sales, Propositions & Industry Engagement lead on AI and governance pursuits, providing solution design, estimates and Responsible AI positions for proposals.
* Contribute Responsible AI and data-trust thought leadership, such as points of view, events and case studies, to build Mivada's reputation and visibility.
* Advise client executives and risk, privacy and compliance stakeholders on AI governance, guardrails and trade-offs in clear, non-technical terms.

description:
Your opportunity
  
  
At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.
  
  
Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region.
  
  
What you have
  
  
**Role Description**
This role offers the opportunity to engineer sophisticated analytics and automation solutions that solve meaningful business problems across multiple teams. You will combine hands-on Power BI, Tableau, Power Apps, Power Automate, data-modeling, and SQL expertise to deliver reliable end-to-end products. You will independently lead defined workstreams, collaborate with stakeholders, and influence solution design within established enterprise architecture and governance standards.
  
  
The position provides exposure to platform modernization, self-service analytics, application development, workflow automation, and reporting migration initiatives. You will also expand your leadership capabilities by mentoring developers, coordinating delivery activities, and acting as a technical point of contact for assigned solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead defined BI engineering and Power Platform workstreams from requirements analysis through design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and production support.
* Design and develop complex Power BI reports, semantic models, Tableau dashboards, Power Apps applications, and Power Automate workflows that address business and operational needs.
* Analyze business requirements, source-system structures, SQL logic, data relationships, and reporting dependencies to recommend scalable technical solutions.
* Develop and optimize advanced SQL queries, views, stored procedures, transformations, and reusable data structures supporting reporting and analytical applications.
* Coordinate delivery with business analysts, product owners, data engineers, platform administrators, architects, and quality-assurance partners.
* Apply enterprise standards for data governance, security, access management, source control, deployment, documentation, testing, performance, and operational readiness.
* Support modernization initiatives involving Tableau-to-Power BI migration, dashboard rationalization, semantic-model development, and replacement of manual processes with automated workflows.
* Manage assigned operational tasks, including incident investigation, production troubleshooting, enhancement prioritization, dependency management, and stakeholder communications.
* Conduct solution-design reviews, SQL reviews, dashboard usability assessments, performance analysis, and reconciliation testing.
* Mentor less-experienced developers, share technical knowledge, and provide constructive guidance on development practices and solution quality.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5-7+ years of progressive experience developing and leading delivery of Power BI, Tableau, Power Apps, and Power Automate solutions.
* Advanced SQL expertise, including query optimization and complex data transformations across enterprise-scale datasets.
* Demonstrated experience leading BI/Power Platform workstreams end-to-end, from requirements through production support.
* Experience architecting governed semantic models and reusable data assets across Power BI and/or Tableau.
* Experience applying enterprise data-governance, security, and access-management standards to BI solutions.
* Proven ability to coordinate cross-functional delivery with architects, data engineers, QA, and business partners.
* Experience leading or significantly contributing to platform modernization initiatives (e.g., Tableau-to-Power BI migration).
* Bachelor's degree in a related technical field (Master's preferred) with demonstrated technical leadership experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with large-scale Tableau-to-Power BI rationalization or migration programs.
* Experience with Power Platform Center of Excellence (CoE) governance and environment strategy.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, DataOps, and CI/CD practices for BI development.
* Experience evaluating or managing BI delivery vendors/consulting partners.
* Advanced Power Automate experience, including approval flows, desktop/RPA flows, and complex connectors.
* Relevant certification(s) such as PL-300, PL-400, or Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect.
* Experience presenting technical roadmaps and recommendations to senior leadership.

What’s in it for you
  
  
At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long-term financial security.
  
  
**Our Base Benefits, Wellbeing, And Total Rewards Include**

* Competitive compensation and retirement programs including Employee Provident Fund (EPF), Gratuity, and optional National Pension System (NPS) contributions
* Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more
* Comprehensive medical insurance with Outpatient Department (OPD) services, including vaccination, pharmacy, dental, and vision coverage
* Annual reimbursement for health check-ups and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Childcare (creche) reimbursement for eligible employees
* Transportation and meal benefits that support your day-to-day work
* Group life, personal accident, and critical illness insurance

description:

Evernorth Health Services India, established in Hyderabad in 2024, is an innovation hub for Evernorth Health Services, the pharmacy, care, and benefits division of The Cigna Group. The India innovation center focuses on generative AI, product development, analytics, process improvement, and software engineering to support global healthcare solutions and business transformation initiatives.

**Position Overview**

Evernorth is a leading health services organization. In this role, you will collaborate closely with the development team on initiatives aligned with Evernorth’s strategic objectives and partner with subject matter experts to accurately translate business requirements and logic into engineering solutions.

The role requires deep subject matter expertise in Master Data Management (MDM), with a strong focus on the Client and Producer domains. The Offshore MDM SME is responsible for ensuring high-quality, reliable, and well-governed master data through operational oversight, data quality management, and cross-functional collaboration.

The Offshore MDM SME will serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and IT teams for Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) Master Data Management initiatives. This individual will provide both functional and technical leadership across MDM and related IDMC services, including Business 360,Customer 360,Refrence 360, Data Profiling, Cloud Data Integration (CDI), Cloud Data Quality (CDQ), and Cloud Application Integration (CAI) supporting complex integration landscapes.

Recognized as a trusted advisor to both business and technology leaders, this individual will contribute to strategic initiatives while ensuring seamless day-to-day operations, effective data governance, and successful delivery of MDM solutions.

**Responsibilities**

* Understand the current technical landscape and the desired future-state architecture. Assess the existing architecture and business processes for managing Master Data Management (MDM) solutions.
* Evaluate the functional and non-functional requirements of the target MDM solution and design the future-state architecture, including data ingestion, data quality rules, data models, match and merge processes, workflows, user interfaces, batch integrations, and real-time services.
* Lead the design, implementation, and evolution of the global Customer Master Data platform. This role requires deep hands-on expertise in the Informatica IDMC Customer 360 SaaS solution, combined with strong delivery leadership capabilities.
* Be accountable for designing and governing the Customer MDM architecture while orchestrating end-to-end Agile delivery across upstream and downstream systems and stakeholder groups. The technology stack is based on Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (Customer 360 SaaS) and Databricks.
* Lead end-to-end MDM development and production operations, including data profiling, data quality components, configuration of business entities, pages, workflows, and business events. Design and develop ingestion and egress jobs, as well as Cloud Application Integration (CAI) processes for job orchestration and scheduling.
* Build and implement Informatica MDM jobs to perform programmatic merges using data received from source files.
* Play a critical role in ensuring high-quality, governed, scalable, and business-aligned customer master data capabilities that support global growth and enhance customer experience.
* Manage and resolve production support incidents through ServiceNow (SNOW), ensuring adherence to defined SLAs, operational standards, and best practices.

**Qualifications**

**Required Skills:**

* Overall 5 + years of hands-on experience in Master Data Management with 3+ years of Informatica IDMC MDM SaaS solution and delivering successful MDM implementations.
* Proven experience with Informatica IDMC Customer 360 SaaS / Multidomain MDM Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services (IICS) Informatica Reference 360 (strong plus) Strong experience integrating MDM with Databricks platforms.
* Deep understanding of: Customer data models Match & Merge strategies Data governance frameworks Data quality methodologies Experience in defining and implementing MDM solution architectures Strong knowledge of batch and API-based integration patterns.
* Experience leading agile delivery in complex, multi-country environments Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills Certifications in Informatica MDM (Developer / Administrator) are a plus.
* Key Competencies Strategic thinker with hands-on technical depth Strong ownership and accountability mindset Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills Ability to balance governance rigor with business agility Strong communication skills across business and technical audiences.
* Strong implementation experience across Informatica MDM SaaS(Business/Customer/Refrence 360), Data Profling,CDI,CDQ and CAI is mandatory.
* Strong SQL, data modeling, integration architecture, performance tuning, and troubleshooting skills.

**Required Experience & Education:**

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline with 5 to 14 years of experience in application program development, or the equivalent in education and work experience.

**Desired Experience:**

* Experience supporting large-scale Informatica SaaS MDM platforms
* Certification in Informatica IDMC MDM technologies.
* Experience in cloud-based data management ecosystems.
* Experience with Informatica CLAIRE AI capabilities.
* Previous Healthcare or health services industry experience

*Evernorth is an Equal Opportunity Employer actively encouraging and supporting organization-wide involvement of staff in diversity, equity, and inclusion efforts to educate, inform and advance both internal practices and external work with diverse client populations.*

**Integration architecture and strategy**

•           Define the target integration architecture linking Veeva Vault (Clinical Operations, eTMF, CTMS, Study Startup, QualityDocs, RIM) with Snowflake and downstream systems.

•           Set integration standards: API-first patterns, event-driven and batch designs, error handling, monitoring and reusable components.

•           Maintain the integration roadmap in partnership with Clinical Operations, Data Management, Biostatistics, Regulatory and Quality.

•           Veeva Vault and Snowflake delivery

•           Lead build of pipelines from Veeva Vault to Snowflake using Vault REST APIs, Vault Loader, Direct Data API, Vault Java SDK and Spark messaging.

•           Integrate CROs, EDC (e.g. Medidata Rave, Veeva CDMS), IRT/RTSM, safety and finance systems with Vault and Snowflake.

•           Keep pipelines in step with Veeva's three general releases per year through regression testing and release impact reviews.

**AI-driven integration automation for CTMS**

•           Design and deploy AI and LLM solutions that automate CTMS data flows: document classification and metadata extraction for eTMF, site and milestone data mapping, and CRO data reconciliation.

•           Build AI agents and workflows (e.g. Snowflake Cortex, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Veeva AI) that detect data anomalies, propose mappings and generate integration code and tests.

•           Put human-in-the-loop review, model validation and performance monitoring in place so AI outputs stay accurate and auditable.

•           Compliance and quality

•           Deliver integrations under GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11 and GAMP 5, including validation documentation (URS, FS, IQ/OQ/PQ, traceability).

•           Apply data integrity (ALCOA+), GDPR and HIPAA controls, including access management and audit trails.

•           Follow a risk-based approach to validating AI components in line with emerging FDA and EMA guidance.

•           Leadership and stakeholder management

•           Lead internal engineers and external partners (system integrators, Veeva Services, CROs); review designs and code.

•           Translate business needs from clinical and quality teams into technical requirements and delivery plans.

•           Report on integration health, costs, risks and benefits to IT and business leadership.

**Required qualifications**

•           Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Life Sciences or a related field, or equivalent experience.

•           10+ years in enterprise integration or data engineering, with 5+ years in pharma, biotech or CRO environments.

•           3+ years leading Veeva Vault integrations (Clinical Operations suite, ideally CTMS and eTMF), including Vault APIs, Vault Loader and Direct Data API.

•           3+ years building on Snowflake: data modelling, Snowpipe, Streams and Tasks, performance tuning, security and cost management.

•           Hands-on delivery of AI or machine learning automation in production integration workflows, preferably for CTMS or clinical operations data.

•           Strong skills in Python and SQL; working knowledge of Java or JavaScript for Vault SDK and middleware.

•           Experience with an integration platform such as MuleSoft, Boomi, Informatica or Azure Integration Services, and with orchestration tools such as Airflow or dbt.

•           Working knowledge of clinical trial processes, study lifecycle and data standards (CDISC, TMF Reference Model).

•           Delivered validated systems under GxP, 21 CFR Part 11 and GAMP 5.

•           Proven technical leadership of engineers and vendors, with clear communication to non-technical
**stakeholders.**

**Preferred qualifications**

•           Veeva Vault certifications (e.g. Vault Platform Administrator, Clinical Operations) and SnowPro Core or Advanced certification.

•           Experience with Snowflake Cortex AI, Document AI or Snowpark for in-platform machine learning.

•           Built AI agents or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions over clinical documents or TMF content.

•           Experience migrating from a legacy CTMS (e.g. Medidata, Oracle Siebel) to Veeva Vault CTMS.

•           Background in oncology or cell and gene therapy trials, or in a commercial-stage biotech.

•           Familiarity with FDA and EMA guidance on AI in drug development, and with the EU AI Act.

Experience working across UK and US teams and with global CRO partners

is a Global Technology Solutions Provider with presence across North America (USA and Canada), Europe (UK and Germany), Middle East & Asia. In India, we have offshore development centres: 2 in Hyderabad & 1 in Pune.

For more than 40 years, Prolifics has transformed enterprises of all sizes including over 100 Fortune 1000 companies by solving their complex IT challenges. **suma.pullagurla@prolifics.com**

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. In this role, you will provide technical leadership and architectural guidance while developing innovative software solutions that enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Working in a supportive, multi-functional environment, you will design and implement sophisticated solutions across our product portfolio, from cloud platforms to scientific instrumentation. You will support the growth of other engineers, drive adoption of best practices, and help shape the technical direction of critical projects. * Build LLM applications using RAG, semantic search, and approved knowledge sources; evaluate retrieval and answer quality.

* Strong Python and software engineering skills; experience with C#/.NET or Java is valuable.
* Applied data science and ML experience, including statistical analysis and supervised or unsupervised methods.
* Experience with multivariate and time-series data, model validation, performance metrics, and uncertainty.
* Experience with data pipelines and SQL or NoSQL databases; time-series or historian data is desirable.
* Working knowledge of MLOps, including reproducible experiments, model versioning, deployment, and monitoring.
* Hands-on chemometrics experience, including PCA, PLS, calibration, and model validation.
* Understanding of LLMs, embeddings, semantic retrieval, vector search, and RAG.
* Experience building LLM applications and evaluating grounding, retrieval relevance, and response quality.
* Knowledge of secure LLM design, data privacy, safeguards, and human review.
* Experience integrating software with industrial or laboratory systems.
* Understanding of process control, instrumentation, sensors, and process data acquisition.
* Experience productizing software or analytics and leading or mentoring multidisciplinary teams.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Spectral or process analytical data experience (such as NIR or Raman), PAT, or bioprocessing experience.
* Familiarity with OPC UA, PLC, SCADA, or MES integration.

Guardant Health is a leading precision oncology company focused on guarding wellness and giving every person more time free from cancer. Founded in 2012, Guardant® is transforming patient care and accelerating new cancer therapies by providing critical insights into what drives disease through its advanced blood and tissue tests, real-world data and AI analytics. **About The Role**
Are you passionate about transforming healthcare through data-driven innovation? The Enterprise Data Platform team is seeking a hands-on Data Engineering Manager to lead the design, evolution, and scaling of our AWS-based enterprise data platform that powers analytics, operational intelligence, AI-enabled solutions, and business-critical decision-making. This role is ideal for a technical leader who combines strong data engineering expertise with architectural vision, product thinking, and a passion for solving business problems through data. As a player-coach, you will contribute to architecture, technical design, and key implementations while mentoring engineers and shaping the future of our data platform. **Platform Architecture & Strategy**

**Data Products & Business Impact**


* Lead the design and delivery of data products that generate measurable business value through analytics, automation, AI/ML, and operational insights.

* Apply a product mindset to data solutions, ensuring investments align with business priorities and user needs.
* Define success metrics and drive adoption, reliability, and business outcomes for data products.

**Team & Culture**

* Hire, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of data engineers.
* Coach engineers in system design, architectural thinking, engineering craftsmanship, and operational excellence.

**Governance & Reliability**

* Ensure strong foundations in data quality, lineage, governance, privacy, security, and compliance.
* Drive platform reliability, monitoring, observability, and operational excellence. Partner with security and governance teams to implement best practices for handling sensitive and regulated data.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or related fields.
* 2+ years of experience leading and growing engineering teams.
* Proven experience building and scaling enterprise data platforms and data products.
* Demonstrated experience delivering measurable business value through data engineering, analytics, AI/ML, automation, or a combination of these capabilities.
* Strong expertise in data architecture, data modelling, distributed data processing, and modern data platform technologies.
* Experience with technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Airflow, cloud-native services, and modern data engineering frameworks.

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: AWS Data Engineer - Data Platform
description:

Zinnia is the leading technology platform for accelerating life and annuities growth. With innovative enterprise solutions and data insights, Zinnia simplifies the experience of buying, selling, and administering insurance products. All of which enables more people to protect their financial futures. Our success is driven by a commitment to three core values: be bold, team up, deliver value – and that we do. You are a

**What You’ll Do**

* Build and maintain scalable, reliable data platforms and pipelines that power analytics and data-driven products across Zinnia.
* Work within the data platform's AWS infrastructure — storage, IAM, compute and orchestration services — implementing and tuning components under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Implement and integrate with telemetry and observability solutions for Infrastructure and Platform reliability.
* Provision and modify data infrastructure components (S3 buckets, IAM roles, Lambda, RDS/Aurora, compute resources) using Terraform, including Snowflake infrastructure-as-code (warehouses, roles, databases), working from existing modules and patterns.
* Familiarity with streaming or event-driven data (Kafka, Kinesis, or similar)
* Package, deploy, and manage pipeline components as containerized services (ex: Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, ECS), including EKS cluster upgrades and configuration changes

* Write clear documentation and follow established technical standards for the data platform.
* Develop and maintain ELT/ETL workflows using Airflow, dbt, and Airbyte (or similar ingestion tools) for self-serve data access
* Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tools and platforms (e.g., Claude, Cortex Code), LLM-based workflows, and agentic automation to support infrastructure and platform changes

**What You’ll Need**

* 4+ years of experience in Data Platform Engineering
* Hands-on experience with AWS core services (e.g., S3, IAM, compute services)
* Good hands-on proficiency in SQL and Python for data transformation and pipeline development.
* Experience with a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake or similar.
* Working knowledge of Airflow for orchestration and scheduling, including managed Airflow (MWAA) or similar hosted-Airflow configuration and environment management.
* Experience/awareness with dbt, including dbt Cloud, for transformations, testing, documentation, and job/environment configuration.
* Solid understanding of data modeling fundamentals (dimensional and fact-based designs).
* Comfort working in agile, cross-functional teams alongside more senior engineers, analysts, and data scientists.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.

**Nice to have:**

* Exposure to MLOps concepts — training data pipelines, feature generation, or model monitoring data.
* Experience with Airbyte or similar ELT ingestion tools.
* Familiarity with CI/CD practices for data pipelines, including building and maintaining GitHub repositories and GitHub Actions pipelines.
* Experience in a regulated industry such as insurance or financial services.

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?**
At Zinnia, you collaborate with smart, creative professionals who are dedicated to delivering cutting-edge technologies, deeper data insights, and enhanced services to transform how insurance is done. Visit our website at www.zinnia.com for more information. Apply by completing the online application on the careers section of our website. We are an Equal Opportunity employer committed to a diverse workforce. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, India
description:
**Job Description**
Who We Are
  
  
Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.
  
  
Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.
  
  
**About The Role**
Notion is looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer focused on migrations to join our growing team in India. You will help deliver complex, production-grade data migrations, integrations, and automations for customers across APAC.
  
  
This is initially an internally focused, hands-on engineering role. You will partner closely with regional Forward Deployed Engineers, who own customer discovery, solution architecture, stakeholder communication, risk management, and final customer validation. You will own the behind-the-scenes technical execution layer from feasibility assessment and implementation through testing, production rollout, QA, reconciliation, reporting, and operational handoff.
  
  
You will work across multiple customer environments and source systems, often with incomplete requirements, imperfect data, and real-world constraints. Success requires strong engineering fundamentals, sound judgment, careful validation, and the ability to turn one-off delivery work into reusable tools and repeatable playbooks.
  
  
As a founding engineer in India, you will help build a new regional engineering capability from the ground up. You will create migration infrastructure, standards, and reusable tooling used by FDEs across APAC, while establishing practices that can scale globally. The role offers an opportunity to become a technical authority for production migration delivery, shaping how Notion approaches reliability, validation, and operational quality across complex customer environments. As the team grows, the role may also expand toward customer-facing FDE work, technical leadership, or a deeper engineering path, depending on business needs and demonstrated capability.
  
  
What You'll Achieve
  
  

* Own the technical execution layer after customer requirements, scope, and solution architecture have been established with the regional FDE. Contribute to feasibility assessment, estimation, implementation planning, and risk identification while the regional FDE remains accountable for customer discovery, scope, architecture, stakeholder communication, and final acceptance.
* Apply a repeatable migration lifecycle covering source inventory and sampling, scope and pruning decisions, compatibility and degradation assessment, transformation design, pilot or dry run, user acceptance testing, production cutover, reconciliation, remediation, hypercare, and documented handoff.
* Translate approved customer and regional FDE requirements into clear technical designs, implementation plans, test strategies, runbooks, and delivery estimates.
* Build production-quality migration utilities, backend services, data pipelines, integrations, and automations using Python, SQL, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure.
* Investigate source-system behavior, data quality issues, permissions, rate limits, authentication constraints, and edge cases, then recommend practical solutions.
* Design and validate permissions, ownership, and inheritance mappings against the approved migration plan. Make unsupported or ambiguous access requirements explicit, obtain the required decision or approval, and preserve evidence of validation.
* Design migrations for reliability, scale, security, observability, idempotency, failure recovery, and safe reruns.
* Execute migrations only through approved environments, devices, accounts, and tooling. Follow least-privilege access, customer-specific security and data-residency requirements, and approved handling procedures. Do not store customer data in unmanaged local or external systems, and escalate privacy, security, or sovereignty concerns before execution.
* Build validation and reconciliation frameworks that provide clear evidence of migration completeness, accuracy, and exceptions.
* Debug failures across application code, infrastructure, customer data, third-party systems, and the Notion platform, then drive issues through resolution.
* Manage multiple implementation workstreams, dependencies, and priorities while communicating scope, progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly.
* Surface scope changes, unsupported requirements, timeline risks, and material effort increases early. Document assumptions and trade-offs, and escalate with options and a recommended path rather than silently absorbing additional work.
* Maintain an auditable record of scope, decisions, risks, approvals, validation evidence, and customer acceptance criteria in the agreed shared workspace or channel.
* Convert repeated delivery patterns into reusable components, automation, documentation, and playbooks that improve speed, quality, and cost over time.
* Bring field learnings back to Notion's Product and Engineering teams as actionable platform feedback and technical requirements.

Skills You'll Need to Bring
  
  

* 3 to 6 years of hands-on experience in backend engineering, data engineering, integration engineering, implementation engineering, technical consulting, solutions engineering, or a similar technical role.
* Strong hands-on Python development experience.
* Working experience with Node.js, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
* Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of relational databases, data modeling, and data transformation.
* Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, authentication, webhooks, and system integrations.
* Experience owning a production migration, integration, or technical implementation through mapping, transformation, testing, rollout, validation, and handoff.
* Experience taking a technical problem from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production operation.
* Experience with Git, code review, automated testing, release practices, and production deployment.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills across code, data, infrastructure, and external systems.
* Evidence of working on production systems, not only prototypes or proof-of-concept projects.
* Clear written and verbal English communication, with the ability to explain technical decisions, constraints, and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* High agency and ownership. You are comfortable making progress with incomplete information, challenging assumptions, and escalating with options and a recommendation.

Nice to Haves
  
  

* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, job orchestration, or infrastructure automation.
* Experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Familiarity with message queues, event-driven systems, distributed-system patterns, retries, concurrency, and rate limits.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, or other observability tools.
* Experience with enterprise SaaS applications, professional services, or large-scale customer implementations.
* Experience migrating large volumes of content or structured data between enterprise platforms.
* Experience with AI or LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation frameworks, or agentic workflows.
* Familiarity with MCP, tool calling, Notion Workers, Custom Agents, or similar extensibility platforms.
* Experience working with distributed global or APAC teams.

What success looks like
  
  
In your first 90 days, you will
  
  

* Learn Notion's migration and implementation ecosystem, engineering standards, and APAC delivery model.
* Establish a productive working rhythm with regional FDE partners.
* Contribute to at least one migration or integration workstream through production delivery.
* Leave behind clear technical documentation, validation evidence, and an operational runbook.

Within your first six months, you will
  
  

* Independently own production migration or integration workstreams from technical design through rollout and handoff.
* Deliver measurable improvements in migration turnaround time, validation quality, delivery cost, or regional FDE execution hours through reusable engineering.
* Help establish repeatable quality controls, code review practices, runbooks, and observability patterns for the India team.
* Demonstrate effective prioritization and communication across multiple concurrent APAC engagements.
* Turn at least one repeated delivery pattern into a reusable tool, component, or playbook that is adopted by a subsequent engagement.

Location
  
  
This role is based in Hyderabad, India. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our Anchor Days, because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We're looking for someone who's excited to work alongside the team during those days.
  
  
By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy.
  
  
A Note on AI
  
  
You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.
  
  
Equal Opportunity & Accommodations
  
  
We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.
  
  
Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
  
Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
  
  
We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  
  
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  
  
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
ADSP owns and manages a set of Authorized Data Sources (ADS) that provide the trusted data behind the bank's regulatory reporting, General Ledger (GL) reconciliation and risk capital models. The ADSP portfolio spans domains: Credit Card, Mortgage, Wealth Management, Consumer Vehicle Lending and Credit Bureau. ADSP maintains accurate data for Finance, Enterprise Risk, Corporate Investments and Global Risk Analytics (GRA) risk models, reconciles Mortgage balances with the bank's GL, and runs ETL from upstream systems, applying enterprise data controls and business rules that meet auditor and regulator expectations.
  
  
**Job Description\***
Bank of America is looking for a senior Technology Leader to build, lead and mature the BVH ODS team in GBS India. This role will own end-to-end delivery across engineering, QA, production support and audit/governance, working closely with US leadership and partner teams. The leader will drive the migration of enterprise batch workloads to AutoSys, extend the SOX Data Guardian solution to new domains, lead large-scale modernization programs, and partner with internal and external auditors to ensure controls and compliance. The ideal candidate is a hands-on technology manager with strong people leadership, stakeholder management and execution skills, and the ability to communicate effectively at all levels of the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***

* Build and mature a multi-functional BVH team in GBS integrating engineering, quality assurance, production support and audit readiness into a single cohesive model.
* Establish knowledge and capability in GBS to reduce key-person dependency and provide coverage across time zones in partnership with the US team.
* Lead the migration of enterprise batch workloads from an in-house scheduling platform to the industry-standard AutoSys scheduling tool, ensuring seamless transition, optimized job orchestration and improved reliability across environments.
* Extend the SOX Data Guardian functionality to the Vehicle domain and ensure the solution is truly domain agnostic and reusable across business domains.
* Drive large-scale modernization and transformation programs, including infrastructure design, application migration, DevOps enablement and platform standardization, while adhering to cost, timeline and quality targets.
* Lead audit and governance activities, partnering with internal and external auditors (EIT, PwC) to validate controls, provide evidence and ensure compliance with regulatory and enterprise standards.
* Own production stability for BVH applications – incident and problem management, root cause analysis, SLA adherence and continuous service improvement.
* Define and enforce engineering, testing and release management best practices, including automation of testing and deployments.
* Manage delivery planning, risks, issues and dependencies; provide clear status and metrics to senior leadership.
* Hire, coach and develop talent; build a strong bench and succession plan for critical roles.
* Partner with US leadership, business, platform, infrastructure and risk teams to align priorities and deliver business outcomes.

**Requirements\***
**Education\***
: BE / B.Tech / MCA
  
  
**Certifications if any:**
NA
  
  
**Experience Range\***
15 - 20 Years
  
  
**Foundational skills\***

* Proven experience leading and scaling multi-functional technology teams (engineering, QA, production support) in a global delivery model.
* Strong hands-on background in data engineering, ETL and batch processing on enterprise data platforms.
* Experience with enterprise job scheduling tools, preferably AutoSys, including batch migration and job orchestration.
* Solid understanding of SOX controls, IT general controls and audit processes; experience working with internal and external auditors.
* Track record of delivering large modernization programs – application migration, infrastructure design, DevOps/CI-CD and platform standardization.
* Strong production support experience – incident, problem and change management, RCA and SLA governance.
* Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases (Oracle / DB2 / SQL Server).
* Excellent stakeholder management, verbal and written communication skills, including with senior leadership.

**Desired Skills**

* Banking / financial services domain experience; exposure to Vehicle or consumer lending domain is a plus.
* ETL tools (Informatica / DataStage), Unix/Linux shell scripting, Python.
* DevOps tools – Jenkins, Bitbucket/Git, Ansible; cloud and container platforms.
* Test automation and data quality/controls frameworks.
* Agile / SAFe delivery practices.

10:00 PM to 7:00 PM IST
