Hyderabad

title: Business Intelligence Engineer, ROW AOP
description:
**Description**
Amazon’s ROW (Rest of World) Supply Chain Analytics team is looking for talented Business Intelligence Engineers who develop solutions to better manage/optimize speed and operations planning while providing the best experience to our customers at the lowest possible price. Our team members have an opportunity to be at the forefront of supply chain thought leadership by working on some of the most difficult problems with some of the best research scientists, product/program managers, software developers and business leaders in the industry, shaping our roadmap to drive real impact on Amazon's long-term profitability. We are an agile team, building new analysis from ground up, proposing new concepts and technology to meet business needs, and enjoy and excel at diving into data to analyze root causes and implement long-term solutions.
  
  
As a BIE within the group, you will analyze massive data sets, identify areas to improve, define metrics to measure and monitor programs, build models to predict and optimize and most importantly work with different stakeholders to drive improvements over time. You will also work closely with internal business teams to extract or mine information from our existing systems to create new analysis, build analytical products and cause impact across wider teams in intuitive ways. This position provides opportunities to influence high visibility/high impact areas in the organization. They are right a lot, work very efficiently, and routinely deliver results on time. They have a global view of the analytical and/or science solutions that they build and consistently think in terms of automating, expanding, and scaling the results broadly. This position also requires you to work across a variety of teams, including transportation, operations, finance, delivery experience, people experience and platform (software) teams. Successful candidates must thrive in fast-paced environments which encourage collaborative and creative problem solving, be able to measure and estimate risks, constructively critique peer research, extract and manipulate data across various data marts, and align research focuses on Amazon’s strategic needs.
  
  
We are looking for people with a flair for recognizing trends and patterns while correlating it to the business problem at hand. If you have an uncanny ability to decipher the exact policy/mechanism/solution to address the challenge and ability to influence folks using hard data (and some tact) then we are looking for you!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Analysis of historical data to identify trends and support decision making, including written and verbal presentation of results and recommendations
* Collaborating with product and software development teams to implement analytics systems and data structures to support large-scale data analysis and delivery of analytical and machine learning models
* Mining and manipulating data from database tables, simulation results, and log files
* Identifying data needs and driving data quality improvement projects
* Understanding the broad range of Amazon’s data resources, which to use, how, and when
* Thought leadership on data mining and analysis
* Modeling complex/abstract problems and discovering insights and developing solutions/products using statistics, data mining, science/machine-learning and visualization techniques
* Helping to automate processes by developing deep-dive tools, metrics, and dashboards to communicate insights to the business teams
* Collaborating effectively with internal end-users, cross-functional software development teams, and technical support/sustaining engineering teams to solve problems and implement new solutions

**About The Team**
ROW (Rest of World) Supply Chain analytics team is hiring multiple BIE roles in planning, inbound and SNOP functions. The role will be responsible for generating insights, defining metrics to measure and monitor, building analytical products, automation and self-serve and overall driving business improvements. The role involves combination of data-analysis, visualization, statistics, scripting, a bit of machine learning and usage of AWS services.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
* 2+ years of Tableau Desktop, Quicksight or other relevant data visualization software experience
* Bachelor's degree or above in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field, or 2+ years of Amazon RME (BB/3P) Full Time Exempt experience
* Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
* Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
* Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
* Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling
* Experience using SQL (Structured Query Language) to pull data from a database or data warehouse
* Experience using Python scripting to process data for modeling

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree or above in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field
* Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including: pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc.
* Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
* Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets
* Experience developing and presenting recommendations of new metrics allowing better understanding of the performance of the business

**SAP Datasphere Consultant with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) reporting skills**
to support data modeling, integration, and analytics requirements. The consultant will be responsible for building scalable data models in SAP Datasphere and developing business-friendly dashboards and reports in SAC.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design and develop data models in SAP Datasphere using spaces, tables, views, associations, transformations, and business entities.
* Build analytical and relational models to support reporting and analytics requirements.
* Integrate data from SAP and non-SAP source systems such as SAP BW, BW/4HANA, S/4HANA, HANA, ECC, flat files, and cloud sources.

title: Python Lead
description:

title: Senior FDE Engineer
description:

Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
The Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, Engineer offers a unique opportunity to join a fun, innovative engineering team within the AI & Data Science (AI&D) - organization. You will be part of AI Studio leading the technical delivery of complex AI and automation solutions through discovery, solution design, build, evaluation, production deployment, early stabilization and measurable value, production deployment, early stabilization and measurable value.
  
  
You will maintain technical continuity across the lifecycle, working with business stakeholders and multidisciplinary teams to shape the simplest viable solution, coordinate execution, make delivery trade-offs, remove blockers and contribute hands-on to critical components. The role combines enterprise solution engineering, applied AI/ML, GenAI, RAG and agents, integration, evaluation, MLOps/LLMOps, security, governance and production operations. Technical accountability complements, but does not replace, explicit product, business, compliance and long-term support ownership.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Lead discovery by clarifying the business workflow, users, intended outcome, value hypothesis, acceptance criteria, operational constraints, data readiness, integration dependencies and production implications;
* Translate complex problems into an executable solution design, delivery plan, technical workstreams, estimates, milestones, dependencies, risks, acceptance criteria, release approach and support transition.
* Build, prototype, review or contribute to critical production components to prove feasibility or unblock delivery, including AI-enabled applications, RAG, bounded agents, intelligent automation, APIs and integrations.
* Define and maintain the integrated architecture across applications, workflows, data and knowledge pipelines, models, retrieval, agents, APIs, enterprise integrations, identity, access controls, observability and human review.
* Orchestrate delivery across full-stack engineering, data science, ML and context engineering, testing, platform, security, compliance and business roles;
* Establish integrated testing, AI evaluation and governance covering functional, performance, security, data, model, retrieval, generation, tool-use, human-oversight and operational behaviour with explicit release thresholds.
* Coordinate production readiness through CI/CD, staged release, monitoring, logging, SLOs, rollback, recovery, runbooks and controlled deployment; support early issue triage, stabilization and transition to the operating owner.
* Communicate evidence, risks, trade-offs and status clearly; measure adoption and value and convert delivery lessons into reusable components, accelerators, standards, documentation and playbooks.

**Basic Qualifications And Experience**

* Doctorate Degree and 1 year of experience in Computer Science, IT or related field OR
* Master’s degree with 8 - 10 years of experience in Computer Science, IT or related field OR
* Bachelor’s degree with 10 - 12 years of experience in Computer Science, IT or related field OR
* Diploma with 12 - 14 years of experience in Computer Science, IT or related field

**Functional Skills**

* Technical discovery, and value framing: Workflow analysis, intended-use definition, feasibility assessment, data and integration readiness, success measures, estimates, dependency mapping and technical go/no-go recommendations.
* Enterprise solution architecture and integration: End-to-end design across applications, APIs, services, data and knowledge flows, models, retrieval, agents, workflows, persistence, identity, security zones, enterprise systems and support boundaries.
* Applied AI/ML and GenAI engineering: Production Python and SQL; classical ML and NLP awareness; foundation-model integration, prompt and context management, RAG, structured output, provenance, citations, bounded tool use, permissions, recovery and human control.
* Evaluation, quality and regulated delivery: Representative evidence, baselines, gold sets, error taxonomies, expert adjudication, model and retrieval quality, task success, safety, latency, reliability, failure analysis, Responsible AI, privacy, validation, auditability and GxP controls.
* Cloud, DevSecOps and lifecycle operations: Cloud-native services, containers, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, versioning, observability, SLOs, staged release, rollback, incidents, disaster recovery, capacity, FinOps, runbooks and MLOps/LLMOps.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Demonstrated end-to-end technical ownership of at least one production AI, ML, software, data or automation solution that delivered a measurable enterprise outcome.
* Strong hands-on proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience designing or reviewing production software, APIs, services, data flows, evaluation pipelines and enterprise integrations.
* Proven ability to turn complex business problems into coherent technical designs, executable delivery plans, acceptance criteria and production-readiness evidence while coordinating multidisciplinary teams.
* Advanced capability in at least one role-defining pillar—Applied AI/ML, GenAI/RAG/agents, full-stack and integration engineering, or AI platform/MLOps—plus credible breadth across the production lifecycle.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Advanced RAG, knowledge and agent systems: Hybrid or graph retrieval, knowledge graphs, source verification, MCP-style integration, durable or multi-agent workflows, policy enforcement and adversarial testing.
* Cloud, data and AI platforms: AWS, Bedrock or SageMaker, Databricks, Spark, Kubernetes, serverless or event-driven systems, infrastructure as code, MLflow, Airflow, Kubeflow, observability and FinOps.
* Full-stack, workflow and automation breadth: JavaScript or TypeScript, modern web applications, API gateways, distributed workflows, process automation, document or vision capabilities and human-AI review experiences.
* Regulated delivery and capability building: Life sciences, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, healthcare, GxP or validated-system experience; reusable frameworks, accelerators, standards, platform capabilities and mentoring.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent critical thinking and ability to create clarity, structure and forward momentum in ambiguous situations.
* Strong technical leadership through influence, credibility, constructive challenge and hands-on problem solving.
* Clear communication of evidence, uncertainty, risks, trade-offs, limitations and delivery status to diverse audiences.
* Sound judgment, ownership and resilience when balancing value, speed, quality, security, compliance, cost, maintainability and supportability across global teams.

**Compensation**
Estimated Pay Range:
  
  
Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.

title: AI Solutions Expert
description:
**Job Title: AI Solution Expert**
**Location : Hyderabad**
**About The Company**
Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally.
  
  
Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.
  
  
At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11,000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.
  
  
B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com.
  
  
**About the Role:**
As an AI Solutions Expert/Specialist, you will own the design, development, and deployment of artificial intelligence solutions that automate and optimize the end-to-end content lifecycle across a global CPG organization. You will work at the intersection of AI engineering and content operations — connecting proofs of concept, MVPs, and enterprise-grade platforms to streamline how content is generated, organized, and delivered across every consumer and professional touchpoint.
  
  
This includes finance, commercial, advertising, social media, e-commerce, email marketing, HCP communications, packaging, point-of-sale materials, in-store activations, and regulatory submissions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Architect and lead AI-driven solutions that automate content creation, adaptation, review, approval, and distribution across all content channels and markets
* Build and maintain production-grade applications on Microsoft Azure, leveraging Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure Cognitive Services, and related platform services
* Integrate large language models, image generation models, video models, and multi-modal AI systems into scalable content workflows
* Design and implement data pipelines that connect AI models to enterprise content repositories, PIM systems, DAM platforms, and downstream delivery channels
* Drive initiatives through the full lifecycle — from POC through MVP to enterprise-scale deployment — establishing engineering standards, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and governance at each stage
* Collaborate cross-functionally with brand marketing, e-commerce, regulatory/legal, medical affairs, creative agencies, and IT to translate business needs into technical solutions
* Evaluate and integrate emerging AI technologies, foundation models, and Azure services to continuously advance the content ecosystem
* Define governance standards for AI model usage, data quality, content compliance, brand safety, and responsible AI practices
* Mentor developers and engineers on AI/ML engineering patterns, cloud-native development, and Azure best practices

**General Business**
**Required Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in software/application development, with a significant portion focused on AI/ML solution engineering
* Hands-on expertise with Azure AI Foundry, Azure Document Intelligence, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI Service, and Azure Cognitive/AI Services
* Strong application development background — ability to build, ship, and maintain production-grade software, not just prototypes or notebooks
* Proven experience with LLMs including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic architectures
* Experience with generative AI for image, video, and/or multi-modal content creation
* Solid experience designing and operating data pipelines in Azure (Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions, Event Grid, or equivalent)
* Proficiency in Python and at least one additional enterprise language (C#, TypeScript, Java)
* Strong understanding of API design, microservices architecture, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/AKS), and cloud-native patterns
* Experience deploying AI solutions through the full maturity curve: POC → MVP → enterprise production
* Hands-on experience with DevOps and MLOps tooling — Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, MLflow, model versioning, drift monitoring, automated retraining, and A/B testing in production
* Working knowledge of database technologies including Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, and data lake architectures (Azure Data Lake, Blob Storage, Azure Synapse)
* Experience building with AI orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or AutoGen
* Familiarity with front-end and full-stack patterns (React or Angular, FastAPI/Flask backends, serverless architectures) to deliver end-to-end solutions.

**Required Technical Skills:**
**Cloud & AI Platform**
Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure Cognitive Services, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Search, Azure Document Intelligence, Azure Bot Service
  
  
Data Engineering
  
  
Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure Event Hub / Event Grid, Azure Functions, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, Blob Storage, Data Lake
  
  
**AI/ML Frameworks**
LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, Hugging Face, PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX
  
  
**Generative AI**
Deep Agents, Agentic Workflow developments, multi-modal pipelines
  
  
DevOps & MLOps
  
  
Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes / AKS, MLflow, Weights & Biases, model registry, CI/CD for ML
  
  
**App Development**
REST / GraphQL APIs, React or Angular, FastAPI / Flask, microservices, serverless, event-driven architectures
  
  
**Security & Governance**
Azure RBAC, Key Vault, Managed Identity, responsible AI tooling, content safety APIs
  
  
**General Business**
Languages: Python, TypeScript / JavaScript, SQL
  
  
Good to Have — Domain & Business Experience.
  
  

* Experience working in or with CPG, FMCG, consumer health, or pharmaceutical organizations
* Familiarity with consumer advertising and media production workflows (TV, digital, social, programmatic)
* Exposure to social media content operations, scheduling platforms, and performance analytics
* Understanding of e-commerce product content (product descriptions, A+ content, marketplace listings)
* Awareness of email marketing and CRM-driven personalization tools (Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Campaign, or similar)
* Experience with HCP and medical affairs communications in regulated environments
* Knowledge of packaging artwork, labeling workflows, and regulatory/legal review cycles
* Familiarity with point-of-sale and in-store activation material production
* Experience with PIM and DAM platforms (Salsify, Akeneo, Adobe AEM, Bynder, or similar)
* Understanding of regulatory submission, claims substantiation, and content compliance frameworks (FDA, EU MDR, local market regulations)
* Exposure to localization and transcreation processes across global markets
* Experience integrating with enterprise platforms such as SAP, Veeva, Salesforce, or Others
* Azure certifications (AI Engineer Associate, Solutions Architect Expert, or equivalent)
* Track record of working in AI Centers of Excellence or capability-building functions
* Experience managing vendor and agency relationships for AI tooling and creative technology

What You’ll Impact.
  
  

* Speed and cost-efficiency of content production across global markets
* Brand consistency and regulatory compliance across all consumer and professional touchpoints
* Data-driven decision-making through AI-powered content insights and performance analytics
* AI agentic automation and process efficiency gains
* The organization’s long-term AI and content technology roadmap

**Why us?**
At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.
  
  
We Are Challengers.
  
  
We are dedicated to making self-care as simple as it should be. That starts with our culture. We are challengers by nature, and this is how we do things:
  
  
All In Together: We keep each other honest and have each other's backs.
  
  
Courageous: We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity.
  
  
Outcome-Obsessed: We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity.
  
  
Radically Simple: We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be.
  
  
Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands.
  
  
www.opella.com/en/careers

Semantic Data Engineer - Senior Experience Guide
  
  

* Guide / 5-10 years -- Primary Skill Area
* Semantic Data Engineering, Knowledge Graphs, Metadata Engineering, AI-Ready Data Products & GraphRAG Enablement

**The opportunity**
Design, build and operationalise semantic data engineering solutions that enable Knowledge Graphs, semantic layers, enterprise search, AI-ready data products, GraphRAG and intelligent data discovery. This role is implementation-focused and bridges data engineering, semantic modelling, metadata engineering and AI-ready data platform delivery. The candidate must be able to engineer semantic models, integrate structured and unstructured data, build semantic data pipelines, support ontology and knowledge graph implementation, and operationalize governed semantic assets across modern lakehouse and enterprise data platforms.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Semantic Data Engineering & Semantic Modelling
* Design and implement semantic data engineering solutions using semantic modelling, ontology implementation, taxonomies, SKOS concepts and governed semantic layer patterns.
* Translate business concepts and architecture guidance into implementable semantic data structures, reusable semantic mappings and operational data products.
* Build semantic models that connect business glossaries, metadata, data lineage, data quality rules and downstream analytics or AI consumption needs.
* Support semantic standards adoption by documenting implementation patterns, naming conventions, mappings and reusable engineering assets.

**Data Modelling & Analytical Data Structures**

* Apply data modelling practices including conceptual data modelling, logical data modelling, physical data modelling and dimensional modelling for semantic and analytical use cases.
* Implement entity, relationship, hierarchy, classification, metric and attribute structures that support relational, lakehouse, graph and semantic layer consumption.
* Support star schema, snowflake schema, domain model, canonical model and Power BI Semantic Model implementation where required for analytical consumption.
* Partner with data architects and semantic architects to ensure data models are reusable, governed, explainable and aligned with enterprise information architecture.

**Knowledge Graph Engineering**

* Build and maintain Knowledge Graph solutions using graph data modelling, graph relationships, entity resolution patterns, classifications and hierarchical structures.
* Implement semantic graph pipelines using RDF, OWL, SPARQL and knowledge graph platforms such as Neo4j, Amazon Neptune and GraphDB.
* Integrate structured, semi-structured and unstructured data into semantic ecosystems and knowledge graph foundations.
* Support GraphRAG, semantic search, enterprise search, vector search and AI-driven knowledge retrieval use cases.

**Data Integration, ETL/ELT & Lakehouse Engineering**

* Develop data integration pipelines using SQL, Python, PySpark, ETL/ELT patterns, APIs, enterprise data integration and metadata-driven engineering patterns.
* Build semantic data pipelines across lakehouse architecture, data platforms, semantic layers, knowledge graph platforms and AI-ready data products.
* Engineer reliable data flows for business glossaries, metadata management, lineage capture, semantic mappings, graph loading and data quality validation.
* Collaborate with platform teams to implement scalable and maintainable semantic data products across lakehouse, warehouse and graph ecosystems.

**AI-Ready Data Products, GraphRAG & LLM Grounding**

* Prepare AI-ready data products that improve LLM grounding, contextual retrieval, semantic search and explainability for AI and GenAI use cases.
* Support GraphRAG, RAG, vector search, semantic search, enterprise search and intelligent agent patterns using trusted semantic data foundations.
* Partner with AI engineering teams to ensure semantic data assets are usable for retrieval, contextual reasoning and AI-enabled data discovery.
* Contribute to agentic AI patterns where semantic metadata, knowledge graphs and governed data products support autonomous discovery or insights workflows.

**Governance, DevOps, Data SRE & Architecture Support**

* Implement metadata management, data governance, data lineage, data quality, access controls and semantic governance integrations using tools such as Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog and Immuta.
* Apply Git, CI/CD, DevOps, documentation, testing and release practices for semantic data pipelines, ontology assets, graph mappings and generated artefacts.
* Support Data SRE and observability practices for semantic pipelines, graph loads, data quality checks, lineage jobs, API integrations and AI-ready data products.
* Provide architecture support, stakeholder collaboration and technical documentation across semantic architecture, data engineering, governance and AI teams.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Skill / capability area - Details**

* Semantic engineering - Semantic Data Engineering, Semantic Modelling, Semantic Layers, RDF, OWL, SPARQL, Ontologies, Taxonomies, SKOS, Business Glossaries, Metadata Engineering.
* Data modelling - Data Modelling, Conceptual Data Modelling, Logical Data Modelling, Physical Data Modelling, Dimensional Modelling, Graph Data Modelling, Power BI Semantic Models.
* Data engineering -Data Engineering, SQL, Python, PySpark, Data Integration, ETL/ELT, APIs, Enterprise Data Integration, Data Pipelines, Lakehouse Architecture.
* Knowledge graph platforms - Knowledge Graphs, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, GraphDB, Graph Data Modelling, Semantic Search, Enterprise Search, GraphRAG, Vector Search.
* Governance and metadata - Metadata Management, Data Governance, Data Lineage, Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog, Immuta, Data Quality, Documentation, Architecture Support.
* AI and operations - AI-Ready Data Products, LLM Grounding, GenAI, Agentic AI, Git, CI/CD, DevOps, Data SRE, Observability, Stakeholder Management.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About AssetMark

AssetMark is a leading wealth management platform dedicated to empowering independent financial advisors. AssetMark's mission is to enable financial advisors to make a profound difference in the lives of their clients. Over 10,000 advisors partner with AssetMark for our investment offerings, innovative technology, advanced services, and expertise, which they use to delight their clients and grow their businesses. We are an integrated team of technologists, investment professionals, and operations experts working to help our clients stay at the pioneering front of wealth management.

Key Responsibilities

• Data Platform Engineering: Design, build, test, and maintain scalable, reliable, and fault-tolerant ETL/ELT pipelines and reusable platform components across Azure and Snowflake.

• Data Ingestion & Source Onboarding: Integrate complex financial data from internal systems, third-party providers, databases, APIs, and files; support batch and near-real-time ingestion patterns where appropriate.

• Integrations, Data Feeds & MDS Support: Develop and operate inbound and outbound integrations and data feeds, support MDS tools and dependencies, troubleshoot production issues, and help ensure reliable delivery to downstream consumers.

• Data Reliability & Operations: Monitor pipeline health, freshness, volume, schema changes, and failures; respond to incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and improve performance, resilience, recoverability, and cost efficiency.

• Data Quality, Governance & Security: Implement automated validations, documentation, lineage, cataloging, access controls, encryption, and sensitive-data protections in accordance with financial-industry governance and security standards.

• Engineering Practices: Use Python, SQL, and fit-for-purpose data tools to deliver maintainable solutions; follow Git-based workflows, code reviews, testing, automated deployment, and CI/CD standards using platforms such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.

• Business & Technical Collaboration: Partner with product managers, business users, operations teams, data stewards, analysts, and engineers to understand processes, clarify requirements, and translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.

• Global Delivery & Continuous Improvement: Participate actively in agile ceremonies, retrospectives, documentation, and knowledge sharing across the GCC and U.S. teams, and responsibly use AI-assisted engineering methods to improve development, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

• Practical experience designing, building, and supporting ETL/ELT pipelines, data ingestion processes, system integrations, and data feeds

• Working knowledge of Python and SQL for data movement, automation, validation, troubleshooting, and operational support

• Experience with cloud data platforms, especially Microsoft Azure and Snowflake

• Familiarity with modern data engineering, governance, and observability tools, including Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran, Monte Carlo, Immuta, and Atlan

• Understanding of orchestration, APIs, database connectivity, file-transfer patterns, scheduling, and dependency management

• Familiarity with medallion architecture and core data modeling concepts used to organize and manage data across platform layers

• Understanding of data quality, lineage, cataloging, access control, privacy, and secure handling of sensitive or regulated data

• Experience with version control, collaborative Git workflows, automated testing, and CI/CD practices

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to investigate ambiguous data, integration, platform, or tool issues methodically

• Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams in a hybrid, globally distributed organization

• Experience in wealth management, asset management, financial technology, or a related financial-services domain is a plus

Qualifications & Experience

• 5-9 years of experience in data engineering, data integration, software engineering, platform engineering, or a related technical role

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience

• Experience working with sensitive or regulated financial data and following secure data-handling practices is required

Why Join AssetMark?

• Build global data capabilities from AssetMark's Hyderabad Technology Center, an important part of our India GCC

• Work across a broad data engineering ecosystem that includes the data platform, ingestion, integrations, data feeds, MDS support, quality, governance, and observability

• Work with modern data technologies while learning industry best practices through structured mentorship from experienced engineers

• Develop both technical and business domain expertise in the wealth management industry, with clear advancement pathways as you grow

• Collaborate with colleagues in India and the United States on meaningful technology that supports financial advisors and their clients

• Access comprehensive training resources, workshops, and learning materials designed to accelerate your professional development

• Enjoy comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, and a supportive work environment that values your growth

• Opportunity to build your career in a high-growth company backed by private equity

title: Data Architect(14+ years)(Local to Hyderabad)
description:
**Data Architect – Enterprise Data & AI Foundations**

**Hybrid to Hyderbad**

Full Time

**Role Summary**

Tachyon Technologies is looking for a hands-on Data Architect to design and lead enterprise data foundations for AI, analytics, automation, GenAI, and reporting use cases, mainly for Microsoft/Azure-based customers.

This role works with customers, business leaders, AI teams, and engineering teams. The Data Architect will assess the current data landscape, define the target-state architecture and roadmap, and set the standards for data lakes, warehouses, lakehouses, and AI-ready data layers. The person will own the architecture decisions and will also work hands-on during design, proofs of concept, and critical build phases.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Work with customer business and technology stakeholders to understand business processes, AI use cases, analytics needs, and reporting requirements.
* Assess current data sources, platforms, data quality, integration gaps, and AI/analytics readiness, and present findings with recommendations.
* Define the target-state data architecture and a phased data foundation roadmap for AI and analytics programs.
* Design enterprise data platforms on Azure and Microsoft Fabric, including data lakes, data warehouses, lakehouses, Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) layers, and curated data products.
* Define conceptual, logical, and physical data models, including dimensional models, canonical models, and semantic layers for Power BI.
* Set integration patterns for batch, near real-time, CDC, API-based, and event-driven ingestion from ERP, CRM, databases, files, APIs, and operational systems.
* Design data architecture for GenAI use cases, including RAG pipelines, document ingestion, chunking and embedding strategy, vector stores, and grounding data for copilots and AI agents.
* Define standards for data security, access control, privacy, metadata, cataloging, lineage, and governance, using tools such as Microsoft Purview and Unity Catalog.
* Set frameworks for data quality, reconciliation, validation, error handling, observability, and pipeline monitoring.
* Make platform and tool choices (Fabric vs. Databricks vs. Synapse, storage formats, compute sizing) and keep cost, performance, and scalability in balance.
* Build reference architectures, reusable templates, and accelerators, and contribute hands-on to POCs and complex pipeline or model development using SQL, Python, and PySpark.
* Review designs and code from data engineers and guide the engineering team on architecture standards and best practices.
* Lead pre-sales architecture work, including customer discovery, solution design, RFP responses, effort estimation, and proposal content for Data + AI programs.
* Present architecture, implementation approach, risks, and roadmap clearly to customer executives and internal leadership.

**Required Skills**

* 12+ years of experience in data engineering, data platforms, or data architecture, with at least 4 years in an architect role.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise data lakes, data warehouses, or lakehouse platforms end to end.
* Deep expertise in the Microsoft data ecosystem: Azure Data Factory, ADLS Gen2, Synapse, Microsoft Fabric (OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse), Databricks, Azure SQL, and Power BI.
* Strong data modeling skills, including dimensional modeling (Kimball), Data Vault, and semantic model design.
* Strong SQL plus working hands-on skills in Python and PySpark.
* Experience defining data governance, security, metadata, and lineage frameworks.
* Experience with integration patterns across APIs, databases, files, and enterprise applications.
* Ability to translate business and AI use cases into architecture, data requirements, and delivery roadmaps.
* Experience leading data engineering teams and setting technical direction across projects.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and executive stakeholder management skills.

**Good to Have**

* Hands-on architecture experience with GenAI, RAG, vector databases (Azure AI Search, Cosmos DB vector, pgvector), semantic search, copilots, or agentic AI.
* Experience with Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog, or other enterprise catalog and governance tools.
* Domain or source-system experience with SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Dynamics 365, or finance, operations, and customer data.
* Knowledge of data privacy and compliance needs (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2, CCPA).
* Experience with streaming tools such as Event Hubs, Kafka, or Fabric Real-Time Intelligence.
* Certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Fabric Analytics Engineer (DP-600), Azure Data Engineer (DP-203), or Databricks Data Engineer Professional.
* Experience with DevOps/DataOps, CI/CD for data pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep).

**Ideal Candidate**

Someone who can sit with customer leadership, understand the business and AI use cases, assess what the data foundation is missing, design the target architecture and roadmap, and then guide the team (and step in hands-on when needed) to build the platform, pipelines, models, and AI-ready datasets.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a Senior Data Analytics Engineer to own and operate our Snowflake data platform. This role supports the data pipelines that feed Snowflake, which in turn power data and reporting presented directly to our customers within our products. The role is primarily focused on
**Snowflake platform administration and data engineering**
— account management, performance/cost optimization, data pipelines (dbt, Fivetran), and the overall health of the platform — with security, access governance, and cloud/DevOps responsibilities as a supporting part of the job.

You'll work closely with platform and product engineering teams and cloud operations to ensure the pipelines and Snowflake environment behind our customer-facing product data are scalable, performant, and reliable.

**What You'll Do**

**Snowflake Platform & Data Engineering (primary focus)**

* Administer and maintain multiple Snowflake accounts, including account-level configuration, org structure, and cross-account governance
* Own Snowflake performance and cost: warehouse sizing, resource monitors, query tuning, and storage optimization
* Manage Snowflake platform changes via infrastructure-as-code where applicable (e.g., Terraform, Snowflake CLI/SQL scripts) and change management processes
* Support and maintain Fivetran connectors for data ingestion from SaaS applications, databases, and APIs
* Support and lightly maintain dbt models (staging, intermediate, mart layers) that feed data into product-facing Snowflake datasets
* Troubleshoot pipeline and transformation issues, including those that intersect with platform-level access or performance, to protect the reliability of data presented to customers
* Integrate Snowflake and pipeline health (job failures, data freshness, query performance) into the team's observability stack for centralized monitoring and alerting
* Contribute to runbooks and postmortems for platform and pipeline incidents

**Security, Access & Cloud/DevOps (supporting focus)**

* Own Snowflake security: role-based access control (RBAC) design, object/data-level permissions, network policies, and data masking
* Manage user access lifecycle — provisioning, de-provisioning, role assignment, and periodic access reviews
* Configure and maintain SSO integration for Snowflake authentication via
  **Microsoft Entra ID**
  , working with the identity/security team as needed
* Apply general cloud SRE/DevOps practices to the data platform — mainly
  **AWS**
  , with some exposure to
  **Azure**
  and
  **OCI**
  — covering IAM, networking/connectivity, monitoring integration, and infrastructure-as-code
* Own access certification and periodic access review cycles for Snowflake, producing evidence for
  **ISO 27001**
  and
  **SOC 2 Type II**
  audits where the underlying product requires it
* Maintain audit logging retention and usage/query history analysis to support security investigations and compliance requirements
* Partner with the compliance/security team on control evidence, remediation tracking, and audit responses specific to the data platform

**What You'll Bring**

* 8+ years of experience in data engineering or data platform administration, with hands-on production experience running 
  **Snowflake**
  (account management, performance tuning, cost management)
* Working knowledge of
  **dbt**
  and
  **Fivetran**
  (or comparable ELT tools) for building and troubleshooting data pipelines
* Strong SQL skills and solid understanding of data warehousing concepts
* Working knowledge of Git-based version control and infrastructure-as-code practices
* Comfort integrating platform/pipeline monitoring into a centralized observability tool
* General cloud SRE/DevOps experience, mainly
  **AWS**
  with some exposure to
  **Azure**
  and
  **OCI**
  , applied to a data platform (IAM, networking, monitoring, automation)
* Practical experience with
  **user access management**
  and SSO configuration for a SaaS/cloud platform (Entra ID/Azure AD experience a plus)
* Familiarity with audit/compliance processes (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2) — access reviews, evidence gathering, control documentation
* Good communication skills — comfortable working with product/platform engineering and security stakeholders

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with
  **Amazon QuickSight**
  or similar BI/visualization tools
* Experience with Terraform or other IaC tools for managing cloud/data platform resources
* Experience with Python or equivalent for automation/scripting
* Experience working in a multi-cloud environment (AWS primary, with Azure and/or OCI)
* SnowPro Core or Administrator certification
* Background or experience with GRC, compliance, or security-conscious SaaS environments

title: Senior Healthcare Data Integration Analyst
description:
**Aliases:**
Senior EHR Data Implementation Analyst (Epic/Cerner), Lead, Healthcare Data Exchange and Interoperability, Senior Clinical Data Mapping and Integration Analyst, Healthcare Data Ingestion and Interoperability Engineer, Senior Clinical Informatics Analyst - Data Integration, Healthcare Implementation Consultant - Data.
  
  
**About Truveta**
Truveta is the world's first health provider led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta's ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a special combination of health, software and big data experience who share our company values.
  
  
Truveta was born in the Pacific Northwest in the USA and has employees who live across the country. As we expand our global footprint with a new presence in Hyderabad, India, we're building a world-class team to help us scale this mission, and high-quality, well-integrated health data is at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
*This job requires daily onsite work at our headquarters in Hyderabad, India.*
**Who We Need**
Truveta is rapidly building a talented and diverse team to tackle complex health and technical challenges. Beyond core capabilities, we are seeking problem solvers, passionate and collaborative teammates, and those willing to roll up their sleeves while making a difference. If you are interested in the opportunity to pursue purposeful work, join a mission-driven team, and build a rewarding career while having fun, Truveta may be the perfect fit for you.
  
  
**This Opportunity**
We are seeking a Senior Healthcare Data Integration Analyst to lead and support the onboarding of member data into the Truveta platform. This role is central to ensuring high-quality, well-integrated data that meets clinical, research, and operational needs.
  
  
The ideal candidate is passionate about working with complex healthcare datasets, uncovering patterns in disparate source systems, and building scalable processes that make downstream analytics efficient and reliable. You will work closely with external member teams and internal engineering stakeholders to profile, map, validate, and automate data ingestion workflows, bringing hands-on experience with clinical applications such as Epic, Cerner, MEDITECH, or Allscripts and with healthcare data standards including HL7, FHIR, and CCDA.
  
  
Working from the Truveta India Development Center, you will partner every day with engineering, product, and member teams in the United States, so regular overlap with US Pacific (West Coast) business hours is part of the role.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead onboarding of data from member source systems and third-party sources into the Truveta platform.
* Partner with external technical and clinical teams to understand source data structures, workflows, and business context.
* Perform comprehensive data profiling to assess completeness, quality, conformance, and integrity.
* Develop and maintain source-to-target mappings aligned to platform data models and standards.
* Define, implement, and validate business and data transformation rules.
* Design and support test automation strategies for onboarding workflows, including validation and regression testing.
* Document onboarding methodologies, transformation logic, data quality findings, and validation processes to ensure reproducibility and knowledge sharing.
* Provide clear, timely communication to stakeholders, from customer-facing discussions to deep technical design sessions.
* Continuously improve onboarding processes to increase scalability, efficiency, and reliability.

**Experience**

* Subject matter expertise in clinical applications and an understanding of how healthcare data supports clinicians, researchers, and patients.
* Strong knowledge of healthcare industry terminology and concepts.
* Hands-on experience with data profiling tools, data quality analysis, and visualization technologies.
* Deep understanding of data warehousing concepts, ETL/ELT processes, and data lifecycle management.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze complex datasets and translate business workflows into technical specifications.
* Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, and external partners.
* A track record of producing comprehensive documentation of methodologies, processes, and findings that supports reproducibility and knowledge sharing.
* Self-starter with a strong ownership mindset and the ability to operate in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

**Key Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or graduate degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Engineering, Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, or related analytical field.
* 6+ years of experience in data analytics, data engineering, or healthcare data implementation roles.
* 3+ years of implementation experience with clinical applications such as Epic, Cerner, MEDITECH, or Allscripts.
* 3+ years of experience analyzing large datasets, with strong proficiency in SQL and Python or R.
* Demonstrated experience with data profiling, source-to-target mapping, and validation testing.
* Experience supporting customer or partner engagement during technical implementations.
* Experience translating clinical workflows into informatics or analytics applications.
* Working knowledge of healthcare data exchange standards (HL7, FHIR, CCDA) and clinical ontologies (ICD, SNOMED, LOINC, RxNorm, CPT, NDC).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with both customer-facing and highly technical audiences.
* Ability to collaborate across time zones in a distributed team, with regular overlap with US Pacific (West Coast) hours.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience at a health system or healthcare technology company.
* Experience with modern cloud-native platforms such as AWS, GCP, Azure, Databricks, or Snowflake.
* Hands-on experience with healthcare integration engines such as Mirth Connect, Rhapsody, or Cloverleaf.
* Experience delivering data implementations for US health system clients from a global delivery or offshore engineering center.

title: Senior Manager, Data & Integrations
description:
**Job Description**
**Sr. Manager, Data & Integrations**
**Summary/Objective**
The Sr. Manager, Data & Integrations is the people leader and delivery owner for isolved's India-based data and integrations personnel. This role is fluent across both sides of the house: on the data side, this person needs to operate at the same architectural depth expected of isolved's Principal Data Architect, including medallion architecture, data mesh, dimensional modeling, data lineage, integrity, and governance, alongside hands-on fluency in Databricks, Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, and Hightouch; and on the integrations side (system-to-system data integrations, ideally built on Workato, with deep API understanding, source and target schema design, master data management, and golden record configuration and management). This person owns hiring, coaching, and performance management for all India personnel on the data and integrations teams, and partners closely with U.S.-based counterparts, including the Manager, Data & Analytics Engineering and the Principal Platform Architect and Principal Data Architect, to coordinate workload distribution, execution, and planning across time zones so that the India team operates as a fully integrated extension of isolved's global data and integrations organization.
  
  
**Core Job Duties**

* Serve as the primary people leader for all India-based personnel on the data and integrations teams, spanning data platform, data engineering, and integration automation disciplines.
* Conduct 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development planning to support the growth of the India team.
* Hire, onboard, and build a high-performing, collaborative India-based data and integrations organization.
* Set clear expectations, provide direct feedback, and address performance issues effectively.
* Partner with U.S.-based counterparts, including the Manager, Data & Analytics Engineering and the Principal Platform Architect and Principal Data Architect, to coordinate workload distribution, execution, and planning across time zones.
* Ensure consistent standards, practices, and quality bar between the India and U.S. data and integrations teams.
* Own delivery of system-to-system data integrations, ideally built on Workato, including source and target schema design and mapping between isolved and its ecosystem of ERP, CRM, and partner systems.
* Own master data management and golden record configuration and management practices for the India team's scope of work, applying matching, deduplication, and survivorship standards.
* Maintain deep, working knowledge of APIs, including how to design, secure, and structure them for reliable, scalable, automated execution.
* Oversee data platform and analytics engineering work in India, including administration and support of Databricks, Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, and Hightouch.
* Own data architecture standards for the India team's scope of work, including medallion architecture, data mesh, dimensional modeling (star and snowflake schemas), data cubes, and materialized views, in partnership with the Principal Data Architect.
* Own data lineage, integrity, and cleanliness standards for India-delivered data work, and ensure the team applies data governance and cataloging practices (e.g., Microsoft Purview, Collibra, or Alation) consistently with global standards.
* Apply data quality and testing frameworks (e.g., Great Expectations, dbt tests) to catch and resolve data issues before they reach downstream consumers.
* Ensure the India team's data pipeline work spans the full lifecycle, from ingestion through transformation, storage, and downstream consumption, including batch and, where appropriate, real-time/streaming patterns.
* Factor data lifecycle, retention, archival, and storage/compute cost optimization into architecture and delivery decisions.
* Maintain expert-level fluency in SQL and strong hands-on fluency in PySpark, sufficient to review, guide, and, when needed, directly contribute to complex data engineering and data architecture work.
* Track and balance capacity and workload across the India team, coordinating handoffs and shared work with U.S. shifts to keep delivery continuous across time zones.
* Represent the India team in global roadmap, planning, and prioritization discussions, bringing India-specific context and constraints into those conversations.
* Serve as an escalation point for production data and integration issues originating from or affecting the India team, coordinating incident response with U.S. counterparts as needed.
* Promote adoption of AI-assisted development and automation tools, and establish metrics to improve engineering productivity and delivery reliability.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with architecture, security, integrations, and analytics stakeholders in both India and the U.S. to ensure platform effectiveness and data integrity.

**Job Complexity**
Works on issues of significant scope and complexity where analysis of situations or data requires evaluation of a variety of factors, including cross-regional business and operational considerations. Establishes objectives and work plans for the India data and integrations organization, and exercises judgment in adapting global standards and priorities to local execution. Erroneous decisions or judgment could result in delays in schedules and may impact the overall success of the function. Develops and administers schedules, staffing plans, and performance requirements for the India team; may have budget responsibilities.
  
  
**Interaction**
Frequently interacts with senior management, functional peer group managers, and cross-regional counterparts in the U.S. and India, normally involving matters between functional areas, regions, or business units. Regularly leads a cooperative effort among India and U.S. team members to align on priorities, execution, and planning across time zones.
  
  
**Supervision**
Manages the coordination of the activities of the India data and integrations organization, with responsibility for results, including costs, methods, and staffing. Understands management practices, particularly around professional development and cross-regional team coordination, and is skilled at handling difficult management situations independently.
  
  
**Experience**
Typically requires a Bachelor's degree and 8-10 years of direct experience in data engineering, data platform engineering, or integration engineering, with 4+ years of people management experience, including experience managing distributed or cross-regional teams.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**
  
  

* 8-10+ years of professional experience spanning both data engineering/data platform work and systems integration work.
* 4+ years of direct people management experience, including hiring, coaching, and performance management.
* Proven experience managing distributed or cross-regional teams, ideally coordinating with U.S.-based counterparts across time zones.
* Well-versed in both the data side of the house (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, Hightouch) and the integrations side of the house (system-to-system data integrations, ideally with Workato).
* Principal-level depth on the data architecture side: strong understanding of medallion architecture, data mesh, dimensional modeling (star and snowflake schemas), data cubes, and materialized views.
* Expert-level SQL and strong hands-on experience with PySpark, sufficient to guide and review complex data engineering and data architecture work.
* Experience with data governance and cataloging tools (e.g., Microsoft Purview) and data quality/testing frameworks (e.g., Great Expectations, dbt tests).
* Experience with Snowflake as a cloud data warehouse platform and Airflow or equivalent tooling for pipeline orchestration.
* Experience with data sharing technologies and patterns (e.g., Snowflake Secure Data Sharing, Databricks Delta Sharing), including the governance and access considerations they require.
* Understanding of data lifecycle management, retention/archival policies, and storage/compute cost optimization.
* Deep understanding of APIs, including designing, securing, and structuring them for reliable, automated execution.
* Strong understanding of source and target schema design and mapping for system-to-system integrations.
* Experience with master data management and golden record configuration and management, including matching, deduplication, and survivorship logic.
* Experience designing and managing CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions) and infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform).
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to independently address complex, cross-regional challenges.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across geographies, time zones, and cultures.
* Demonstrated ability to translate global priorities and standards into local execution plans.
* Preferred Qualifications:

+ Direct hands-on experience with Workato
+ Experience with Parabola.io or comparable low-code automation tools
+ Familiarity with streaming/real-time data technologies (e.g., Kafka, Event Hubs) as a complement to batch pipeline experience
+ Hands-on experience with big data ecosystem services such as Hadoop, Hive, HBase, YARN, and Spark
+ Professional services or customer-facing implementation experience
+ Experience operating in a follow-the-sun or globally distributed delivery model

**Position Details**
**Physical Demands:**
Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  
  
**Travel Required:**
Yes, up to 15% travel may be required, including periodic travel to the U.S. for team and stakeholder alignment.
  
  
**Work Authorization:**
Employee must be legally authorized to work in India.
  
  
**FLSA Classification:**
Exempt
  
  
**Location:**
India (Hybrid/Remote)

Sr. Manager, Data & Integrations

[Insert Date]

isolved is an employee experience leader, providing intuitive, people-first HCM (Human Capital Management) technology. title: New - Digital - SM
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Position Name : EY- Assurance – Manager - Digital**
**Position Details**
As part of EY GDS Assurance Digital, you will be responsible for implementing innovative ideas through AI research to develop high growth & impactful products.
  
  
You will be helping EY’s sector and service line professionals by developing analytics enabled solutions, integrating data science activities with business relevant aspects to gain insight from data. You will work with multi-disciplinary teams across the entire region to support global clients.
  
  
This is a combination of a technical role and a business development role in AI, responsible for creating innovative solutions by applying AI based techniques for business problems. As our in-house senior AI engineer, your expertise and skills will be vital in our ability to steer one of our Innovation agenda.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Requirements (including experience, skills, and additional qualifications)**

* Talk to businesses across Assurance teams and understand the problem and develop the solution based on problem, infra and cost limitations
* Respond to AI related RFPs and business cases
* Ensure team’s utilization and billability – i.e ensure that the projects are lined up for developers on after the other

+ SQL/NoSQL Databases and its manipulation components
+ Working knowledge of API Deployment (Flask/FastAPI/Azure Function Apps) and webapps creation, Docker, Kubernetes.

* Excellent written, oral, presentation and facilitation skills
* Ability to coordinate multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously through effective prioritization, organization, flexibility, and self-discipline.
* Must have demonstrated project management experience.
* Knowledge of firm’s reporting tools and processes.
* Proactive, organized, and self-sufficient with ability to priorities and multitask.
* Analyses complex or unusual problems and can deliver insightful and pragmatic solutions.
* Ability to quickly and easily create/ gather/ analyze data from a variety of sources.

* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 7200 + professionals, in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.

Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

description:

*all*
.**
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Micron Technology’s vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life, and our commitment to people, innovation, tenacity, collaboration, and customer focus allows us to fulfill our mission to be a global leader in memory and storage solutions. Do you believe that data provides groundbreaking insight? Do you see data as an asset that builds a competitive advantage? Great…so do we!
  
  
Micron Technology operates in a highly competitive industry where innovation depends on hardworking minds extracting fresh insights from an ever-expanding data universe. We are seeking a technically strong Solution Architect who can design and build innovative, rock-solid data science, AI/ML, and Agentic AI solutions for Smart Manufacturing use cases. We have a diverse, collaborative environment where problem solving is a team sport and creative solutions are recognized and rewarded. Does this sound like the right team for you? Apply today!
  
  
Solution Architects in this role partner with Data Scientists, AI Engineers, and AI Product Owners to architect scalable and innovative data science solutions in technology domains such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Gen AI, Big Data, and Internet of Things (IoT) using both on prem and cloud-based platforms.
  
  
In this role, you will need to be technically sound and capable of crafting innovative end-to-end designs to solve highly complex business problems. We are looking for team members who enjoy learning, introducing new technologies, and building scalable solutions that drive value for the business. The ideal candidate will have significant experience architecting enterprise data and analytics platforms, especially in cloud-based and hybrid environments, and the ability to dive deep into hands-on technical solutions while mentoring others through strong technical leadership.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

description:

At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We are seeking an Associate Manager Data Quality & Governance Operations to join our Data Governance team, supporting our Data Analytics and Data Science organization in a hybrid work model. **Discover Your Role**

* Lead data quality workstreams within Snowflake, designing, implementing, and monitoring controls for assigned data domains while coordinating thresholds and remediation with data owners.

* Experience designing and implementing data quality controls within a structured governance, compliance, or regulated environment.

description:

The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.
  
  
**Pay And Benefits**

* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

The Impact You Will Have in This Role
  
  
The Technology Data Office (TDO) is responsible for improving the quality, consistency, and trustworthiness of technology data across DTCC by providing data governance oversight in a systematic and federated manner.
  
  
As a Senior Associate within the Technology Data Office, you will play a critical role in operationalizing DTCC’s Data Governance Policy, Standards, and Procedures across assigned business and functional domains. This role focuses on executing and supporting day‑to‑day data governance and data stewardship activities that strengthen governance, accountability, compliance, and data quality—ensuring enterprise standards are applied consistently.
  
  
This position operates in a fast‑paced environment with shifting priorities and works closely with agile, cross‑functional delivery teams, data stewards, data owners, project managers, and technology partners to reduce data risk and improve Data Office adoption across the enterprise.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities**
Data Governance & Stewardship Execution
  
  

* Develop, implement, and maintain data governance standards, guidelines, procedures, job aids, and best practices.
* Actively review and update governance documentation to reflect emerging industry standards and evolving enterprise needs.
* Partner with stakeholders and end users to enforce governance standards or remediate non‑standard data usage.
* Develop and maintain metadata repositories and enterprise data catalogs.
* Provide guidance to projects and delivery teams on data governance principles and requirements.

Data Quality Management & Reporting
  
  

* Assist in the identification, documentation, onboarding, tracking, and management of Data Quality Exceptions.
* Coordinate remediation efforts with data owners and data stewards, including evidence collection and validation.
* Monitor, analyze, and report on data quality metrics, KPIs, and trends.
* Design and maintain Power BI governance dashboards.
* Implement automated data quality metrics and KPIs to support transparent reporting and measurement of governance program progress.

Collaboration, Enablement & Adoption
  
  

* Collaborate with and support data stewards across the enterprise on governance and data quality best practices.
* Conduct education sessions and working sessions with Data Stewards to align on governance standards, reporting, and expectations.
* Drive awareness and adoption of Technology Data Office standards and practices.

Risk, Issue & Delivery Support
  
  

* Assist in risk and issue management related to data governance and data quality.
* Align risk and control processes into day‑to‑day responsibilities, escalating issues as appropriate.
* Work closely with project managers and Scrum Masters to create and update project plans where governance activities are required.
* Partner within agile, cross‑functional delivery teams to ensure data governance requirements are clearly understood and incorporated into solutions.

**Qualifications**

* 6+ years of experience in data governance, data quality, data stewardship, metadata management, or data management within an enterprise environment.
* Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent professional experience.
* Experience supporting data governance and stewardship activities within a business or functional domain.

Talent Needed for Success
  
  

* Strong understanding of data governance concepts, including: - Data Elements (DEs) and Critical Data Elements (CDEs)
* Metadata and data lineage
* Data quality rules, metrics, and exception management
* Ability to analyze datasets to identify data issues, inconsistencies, and risks.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain data concepts to both technical and non‑technical audiences.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and operate effectively in ambiguity.

Tools, Frameworks & Methodologies
  
  

* DAMA‑DMBOK framework (conceptual understanding required; implementation experience a plus)
* Collibra (data catalog, governance workflows)
* Monte Carlo (data quality / observability)
* Power BI (governance dashboards and reporting)
* Experience working in Agile, cross‑functional delivery environments

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in regulated or risk‑sensitive environments.
* Background in data stewardship with progression into governance‑focused responsibilities.
* CDMP certification (preferred but not required).
